programme.title: 長歌行:10
programme.desc: 原是永寧郡主的李長歌因玄武門之變父喪母亡，她僥倖逃出城，赴幽州求援；途中，偶遇化名秦准的草原部落特勤阿詩勒隼，兩人不打不相識，漸生英雄相惜之感長歌在幽州粉碎一場陰謀，但郡主的身份卻敗露，前往?州避禍長歌藏於?州太守公孫恆身邊，助其共抗草原勢力侵襲，卻未想到敵方將領阿詩勒隼竟是自己的舊識秦准

programme.title: 奇謀妙計五福星
programme.desc: 茶壺死氣喉凡士林鬈毛積及劉克司五人出獄後決定改邪歸正，與鬈毛積的妹妹（妹頭）同組五寶清潔公司某次匪徒正交易偽鈔電版時遇上劫匪，剛巧被 CID 看見便一路追趕，後劫匪情急下將電版拋進五福星之清潔車中五寶開始被兩大反派追殺，最後五福星施展奇謀妙計應付兩大反派

programme.title: 戲班遇到鬼
programme.desc: 四處巡迴演出的勝秋歌仔戲班，團長阿在有色無膽又怕老婆，但是團長夫人秀姊作風阿沙力，對團員照顧有加.....

programme.title: 警察故事續集
programme.desc: 皇家香港警察隊重案組警長陳家駒成功緝拿大毒梟朱滔搞垮其販毒集團後，卻因屢次違反上級命令嚴重破壞公物後遭到署長調職當交警期間，朱滔因身患絕症而只剩三個月生命，因此獲得保外就醫而走出法院，揚言要對家駒報復

programme.title: 我的老婆是老大3-韓語
programme.desc: 阿玲是香港最強的黑道組織頭目林會長的女兒，由於組織間的勢力衝突，林會長不得不送阿玲去韓國東方派楊會長的地盤上暫避風頭，而楊會長對此事也甚為重視，特意派出組織裏的3號人物基哲負責保護阿玲的安全然而無巧不成書的是基哲一行人並不知道阿玲的真正身份把阿玲當成了觀光的遊客無比傲慢，而身份大揭開後則是無比驚恐 中國話講的半通不通的基哲緊急招聘延邊女孩延熙作翻譯，而延熙夾在這兩個劍撥弩張火氣沖天中的黑道人物之間，誰也不敢得罪，只能憑主觀翻譯，笑料百出可是一直要取阿玲性命甚至跨國追蹤的殺手們的到來使阿玲的性命危在旦夕，而她身邊的所有人也被牽連

programme.title: 師兄撞鬼
programme.desc: 幹探張標在偵查製毒機關時遭毒梟槍殺，死後在天堂法庭受審，法官准其回到凡間緝兇，更指點他尋找有梅花胎記之救星協助報仇張標尋得其救星乃乖巧滑頭學警阿星，逐暗中保護張標現身向阿星表明來意，令阿星又驚又喜，人鬼卒達成協議，張標負責幫阿星泡妞立功，阿星則助他尋兇報仇

programme.title: 瘋狂的外星人
programme.desc: 號稱銀河系最先進的外星文明試圖和地球建交，然而一連串的誤會導致意外不斷外星使者的太空船墜落中國某城市的世界公園中，由於失去超能力和裝備，它竟被耍猴戲維生的耿浩（黃渤 飾）和酒販大飛（沈騰 飾）當成南美洲的猴子，並訓練起來與此同時，之前和外星人交流失敗的超級大國，正根據外星人留下的訊息，在各國間尋找外星使者

programme.title: 碧血劍:4
programme.desc: 夏雪宜?綽號金蛇郎君，全家被溫家堡之惡人慘殺，誓要報仇遇上溫儀後被儀的純真與善良打動，結成愛侶可惜溫儀被溫家堡利用，令雪宜身中劇毒及被挑斷手筋腳筋，儀欲將溫家惡行公開而遭活埋井下亡在生死關頭，雪宜被何紅藥救走並逼婚，結果被打斷雙腳，秘密囚於五毒教的靈蛇洞內 袁承誌?袁崇煥之子，立誌長大後保衛國家父被曹化淳誣害慘死，並誅連九族，承誌被夏雪宜所救，隨後在華山學藝，誓報父仇

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳:5
programme.desc: 這是南宋年間一個英雄成長的故事，忠良之後郭靖，生於亂世，長於大漠，與黃蓉一見如故，這一對兩情相悅的青年，經歷了三番五次的離合悲歡和七曲八折的坎坷磨難，這位淳樸憨厚，忠肝義膽的射雕英雄，終於成為一個為國為民，悲天憫人的俠之大者

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳:6
programme.desc: 這是南宋年間一個英雄成長的故事，忠良之後郭靖，生於亂世，長於大漠，與黃蓉一見如故，這一對兩情相悅的青年，經歷了三番五次的離合悲歡和七曲八折的坎坷磨難，這位淳樸憨厚，忠肝義膽的射雕英雄，終於成為一個為國為民，悲天憫人的俠之大者

programme.title: 門徒
programme.desc: 鬧市上一個平庸的電器行老闆昆哥，暗夜中卻搖身一變為香港最大的海洛因毒梟香港警隊毒品調查科探員阿力花了近七年時間臥底，終於成為昆哥的左右手，務求搗破這個販毒集團...

programme.title: 勝者為王
programme.desc: 山雞被三聯幫委以重任，為促成幫會與日本山田組聯盟，他娶五代目草刈一雄的女兒草刈菜菜子為妻，特地從台灣回港送喜帖給浩南包皮等人

programme.title: 開心鬼
programme.desc: 朱秀才連考十多次也未中狀元，老父因此氣得病逝，老婆也離他而去，無奈之下朱在一座廟裡懸樑自盡，不料心中有冤屈，無法投胎轉世，靈魂只有附在自盡那條麻繩上 八十年代，高中學生林青青林小花及顏如玉在假期旅行中為避暴風雨，誤闖進古廟，青在忙亂中將麻繩帶回宿舍，靈魂附在麻繩上的朱也跟被帶進學校，鬧出不少笑話朱與她們成了好朋友，並規勸她們要靠自己的能力去創造未來，而朱亦因此沉冤得雪，投胎轉世

programme.title: 長歌行:11
programme.desc: 原是永寧郡主的李長歌因玄武門之變父喪母亡，她僥倖逃出城，赴幽州求援；途中，偶遇化名秦准的草原部落特勤阿詩勒隼，兩人不打不相識，漸生英雄相惜之感長歌在幽州粉碎一場陰謀，但郡主的身份卻敗露，前往?州避禍長歌藏於?州太守公孫恆身邊，助其共抗草原勢力侵襲，卻未想到敵方將領阿詩勒隼竟是自己的舊識秦准

programme.title: 陪你很久很久
programme.desc: 憨直的九餅從小就暗戀著青梅竹馬薄荷，兩人一路相互陪伴，卻始終維持著好朋友的關係誰料一上大學，九餅意外地與甜美高中生夏天成為同房室友，又在迎新試膽大會時，不小心將薄荷推向校園天菜麥子學長懷中，眼看著心愛的她即將被追走，九餅究竟要如何守住薄荷，為自己的青春奮力一搏！

programme.title: 黑道診所
programme.desc: 位於市中心邊緣的黑道診所是前白龍幫退休老大左白龍所開設的，所有黑道幫派有個不成文的規定，所有受傷的道上兄弟都送到黑道診所裡診所裡迷糊的小護士小艾總是笨手笨腳，明明快好的傷口都已經結痂了，卻在換藥時太過大力撕開而血流不止原本在槍林彈雨中出生入死的黑道兄弟們，直到住院這幾天才知道什麼叫做害怕！每當聽到小艾在門口喊著換藥囉！黑道兄弟們便開始手心冒汗嘴唇發白

programme.title: 奇謀妙計五福星
programme.desc: 茶壺死氣喉凡士林鬈毛積及劉克司五人出獄後決定改邪歸正，與鬈毛積的妹妹（妹頭）同組五寶清潔公司某次匪徒正交易偽鈔電版時遇上劫匪，剛巧被 CID 看見便一路追趕，後劫匪情急下將電版拋進五福星之清潔車中五寶開始被兩大反派追殺，最後五福星施展奇謀妙計應付兩大反派

programme.title: 鍾馗誅妖傳
programme.desc: 唐朝時期妖怪肆虐，天神因而封印妖王沐風的妖力，使其無法作亂妖王的伴侶，千年花妖風四娘，為了解除封印，便到處尋找捉妖天師鍾馗的下落面對強妖來襲，鍾馗為了保護百姓，想出一招險記來對付風四娘

programme.title: 逆轉勝
programme.desc: 小香（黃姵嘉飾）是明星高中品學兼優的好學生，也是學校的儀隊隊長，青春無敵堅強不服輸但在父母相繼過世後，可觀的債務讓家裡經營的撞球館面臨倒閉命運不但引來社會局上門關切，強制介入安排寄養家庭，更有黑道討債集團威脅逼迫還款腹背受敵走投無路的小香只好與好友黑輪（劉以豪飾）商量，費盡千辛萬苦，找到十年前的一代撞球球王，卻因欠債跑路，至此人間蒸發的叔叔雙丰（溫尚翊飾）回來擔任監護人

programme.title: 小孩不笨2
programme.desc: 片中以家長管教子女時所面對的困難為主題，真實反映青少年在學校及家庭裡所需面對的壓力透過TOMJERRY及成才的故事，讓觀眾能體會到孩子們不只是需要父母親的關愛，他們更需要父母親給予他們的賞識及肯定此片是一部笑中有淚充滿教育性質的輕鬆喜劇，絕對適合全家大小一同觀賞，更能讓現代父母了解，天底下沒有教不會的小孩，只有不會教的父母

programme.title: 狄仁傑之四大天王
programme.desc: 狄仁傑（趙又廷飾）大破神都龍王案，獲御賜亢龍?，並掌管大理寺，使他成為武則天（劉嘉玲飾）走向權力之路最大的威脅武則天為了消滅眼中釘，命令尉遲真金（馮紹峰飾）集結實力強勁的異人組，妄圖奪取亢龍?神都洛陽接連發生奇案，頭戴蚩尤鬼面的武士團四處行兇；酒館外的狐狸通曉人語；紫微宮儀鸞殿柱子上的雕龍活了過來在醫官沙陀忠（林更新飾）的協助下，狄仁傑既要守護亢龍?，又要破獲神秘奇案，還要面對武則天的步步緊逼，大唐江山陷入了空前的危機之中

programme.title: 機場特警:4
programme.desc: 香港警務處機場特警組（ASU）是一支準軍事化特種警察部隊，責任是維持機場警區的公共及航空安全反恐要員保護及災難支援等等故事由一宗機場劫案引發，一名疑犯逃走引發一宗嚴重交通意外，休班警員張景山（張振朗飾）章振赫（黃子恆飾）及辛凱晴（蔡思貝飾）剛好來到機場，參與現場救人及捉拿疑犯的行動

programme.title: 天天天晴:23
programme.desc: 龍福是本地名門石敢當集團旗下的珠寶店，在老闆娘明心安領導下，經歷九七回歸亞洲金融風暴沙士和金融海嘯等大大小小風波，由瀕臨結業至成為數一數二的珠寶店品牌精明的心深受店內員工及同行敬重，令人艷羨雖然風光背後事業和家庭各有隱憂，但樂觀的她積極面對，充滿正能量

programme.title: 踩過界2:25
programme.desc: 綽號盲俠的失明大律師文申俠（王浩信飾）擁有超強的四感，他聯同女師爺趙正妹（蔡思貝飾）私家偵探谷一夏（張振朗飾）為弱勢社群爭取公義，不惜採取踩界手法大律師邵美娜（張曦雯飾）主動接近申俠，二人及後會於法庭對壘，在美娜背後支援的還有其師父簡紹宏（秦沛飾） 申俠於多年前的實習期曾拜紹宏為師，期間卻因一宗無屍命案而師徒決裂；申俠提出新證據為被告上訴，與紹宏再次交鋒，引發連場惡鬥！美娜的出現，同時亦令申俠正妹一夏這個鐵三角組合的關係，產生微妙變化

programme.title: 翻生武林:11
programme.desc: 朝廷打壓武林，五大派被收編英雄名冊，交由東廠提督仇不群管治，江湖名存實亡，英雄不再！玉雲龍跟姐姐嬌鳳經營平安客棧，一直遠離武林中事但雲龍為奪舊愛艾冰冰芳心，決意逐鹿新晉英雄大賽，卻因揭發東廠黑幕被押入大牢嬌鳳為救雲龍，訛稱平安客棧暗藏異寶，招致各路隱世英雄齊集仇在心奉義父不群之命親近雲龍探查寶物，與雲龍漸生情愫，二人更無意中救出被困多年的武林盟主任我飛！沉睡多時的武林，可會因此翻生？

programme.title: 翻生武林:12

programme.desc: 台灣最美的風景是人，台灣最甜的味道是貼心，台灣最真的味道是豪爽， 台灣最頂尖的味道是創意，台灣百味集結在地軟實力增加世界決戰力

programme.title: 震震有詞
programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.title: 城中之城
programme.desc: 聚焦2018年前後金融改革與發展，以兩代金融人的迷茫與奮鬥守正與搏殺的人生抉擇為切入口，全景式地展開金融城內銀行證券信託投行地產商等各色人等的命運沉浮，折射出金融改革與發展大時代的奔湧浪潮！

(Joe是中学生乐队的老师,他的生活并没有像他所期望的那么好。他真正的激情是爵士。但是当他去另一个地方帮助别人找到他们的激情时,他很快就发现拥有灵魂意味着什么。)

programme.title: Unexpected Grace (意外恩典)
programme.desc: When Grace finds a note from a schoolgirl looking for a friend, she writes back and sets off a chain of events that changes the lives of three people. (当Grace从一个女学生找到一张纸条 找一个朋友时 她回信 引发了一系列事件 改变三个人的生活)

programme.title: Hansel Gretel: Warriors Of Witchcraft (汉塞尔·格雷特尔:魔术的战士)
programme.desc: Twins discover a coven of witches. The brother is recruited to join while the sister uncovers their heritage as witch slayers. When the brother is supposed to sacrifice his sister they instead team up to destroy the Witch of the Woods. (双胞胎发现了一个巫师团队. 兄弟被招募加入,而妹妹发现了他们的遗产作为巫师杀手. 当兄弟应该牺牲他的妹妹时,他们相反团结起来摧毁森林的巫婆.)

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln: Vampire Hunter ((吸血鬼猎人林肯))
programme.desc: Abraham Lincoln, the 16th President of the United States, discovers vampires are planning to take over the United States. He makes it his mission to eliminate them. (美国第十六任总统林肯发现吸血鬼计划占领美国,)

programme.title: Fast Furious 9 ((速度与激情9))
programme.desc: Dom Torettos peace and quiet is shattered when the sins of his past catches up to him in the form of his forsaken brother, putting the lives of his loves ones in danger. (托雷托斯的和平与安宁被打破了, 当他过去的罪恶以遗弃的兄弟的形式抓住他,)

programme.title: The Super Mario Bros. Movie ((超级马力欧兄弟大电影))
programme.desc: The film follows brothers Mario and Luigi, who is transported into a whirlwind adventure through Mushroom Kingdom to save the world from a ruthless fire-breathing Koopa named Bowser. (电影讲述了兄弟马里奥和路易奇,他们被运送到风的冒险中,通过王国拯救世界免于一个无情的火焰吸的科帕叫博萨尔.)

programme.title: Break In (突入)
programme.desc: A woman recently separated from her wealthy husband is terrorized during one harrowing night when a masked intruder breaks into her home. Is it a random home invasion or is something more malicious and personal going on? (一个最近与富有的丈夫分开的女人在一个可怕的夜晚被一个蒙面入侵者入她的家中时感到恐惧.)

programme.title: Yang Sudi Tinggal Ep01 ((帅哥露丁丁 Ep01))
programme.desc: From national athlete to educator, discover Emilys story and how Astro is changing her future. (从国家运动员到教育者, 发现艾米丽斯的故事和星体是如何改变她的未来。)

programme.title: Spring Blossoms ((新一剪梅))
programme.desc: Three single females and the men they fall for think things are simple and blissful until the lasses parents enter into the picture. (三个单身的女人和他们爱上的人认为事情是简单的,幸福的,直到女孩的父母进入了这个画面.)

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot ((少林海燈大師))
programme.desc: Alongside the equally famous Lo Lieh, superstar David Chiang plays noble warrior monk Chih Shim, the monk who saved the Southern Shaolin Temple. (超级明星戴维·清扮演了崇高的战士僧侣奇希·希姆,拯救了南方沙olin寺的僧侣.)

programme.title: Legend of the Fox (狐的传说)

programme.title: The Kid With a Tattoo ((通天小子红枪客))
programme.desc: Starring kung-fu comedienne Wang Yu on a mission of justice, this film is kicked into high gear by Yuen Hua, Yuan Pin and the villainous Wang Lung-wei. (在司法任务中主演的拳喜剧女演员王,这部电影由华,平和恶棍王龙威起.)

programme.title: Inside the Forbidden City ((解密紫禁城))
programme.desc: This film marks the Shaw Brothers quintessential Huangmei Opera costume drama, with a superb performance from Ivy Ling Po and Chin Feng. (这部电影标志着肖兄弟的典型黄美歌剧服装剧,)

programme.title: The Mighty One ((后院活宝))
programme.desc: The famed Ivy Ling Po plays a mysterious swordswoman, who teams up with the Roving Knight in a battle against a string of intimidating villains. (著名的常春藤林宝扮演神秘的剑女 她和流浪骑士联手 与一连串的恐怖恶棍作战)

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber ((红楼梦))
programme.desc: This epic classic charts a romance between two teenage cousins, who pursue their relationship despite objections from their respective families. (这部史诗经典描绘了两个青少年表弟之间的浪漫关系,)

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters (主人的挑战)
programme.desc: 17-year-old Wong Fei Hung is prompted to go and do battle to avenge a friends death and protect his family honour. (17岁的菲被迫去战斗,报复朋友的死亡,)

programme.title: Break Up Club (打破俱乐部)
programme.desc: Jaycee Chan plays a 20-something slacker who discovers a magical website that may help reunite him and his girlfriend but at what cost? (杰西扮演一个20岁的惰人,他发现了一个神奇的网站,)

programme.title: No One Like Me ((乱马½))
programme.desc: Yang Qian Huan, once a golden boy, sees his glory fade after the birth of Xu Qi An. Yet, rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate. (,曾经是一个金子男孩,在徐安出生后看到他的荣耀消失.)

programme.title: True Love For Once In My Life ((浅浅岁月))

programme.title: Schemes in Antiques ((古董局中局))

programme.title: Cape No. 7 ((海角七号))
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer tries to deliver seven old love letters attentioned to a Tomoko. As he falls in love with a young Japanese model also named Tomoko, he unravels their serendipitous connection. (一位台湾歌手试图向一个莫科传递七封古老的爱情信.当他爱上一个名叫莫科的年轻日本模特时,他发现了他们的偶然联系.)

programme.title: Marriage with a Liar ((婚前试爱))

programme.title: Relentless Fury ((赴汤蹈火))
programme.desc: A mercenary team led by Captain Lin must protect a mysterious woman bearing the highest bounty in dark web history from global assassins, including an infamous fugitive in a deadly fight for survival. (林上尉率领的雇佣兵小组必须保护一个神秘女人 拥有黑暗网络史上最高的赏金 免受全球刺客的伤害 包括一个臭名昭著的逃犯)

programme.title: A Gilded Game ((猎金游戏))
programme.desc: A finance interns rapid rise under a top analyst ends when he betrays his mentor for a rival. To redeem himself and stop a hostile takeover, he must seek help from the man he wronged. (金融实习生在顶级分析师的领导下迅速升级,他背叛他的导师为竞争对手.)

programme.title: No information available ((特德·姜：))
programme.desc: No information available (没有信息)

programme.title: Limbo ((丛林地狱))
programme.desc: After accidentally killing veteran detective Zhans wife, Wang Tao seeks redemption by assisting Zhan in tracking a serial killer. However, her involvement puts her in grave danger. (道在意外杀死老侦探斯的妻子后,通过帮助斯追踪一名连环杀手来寻求赎回.)

programme.title: Royal Tramp II ((鹿鼎记II：神龙教))
programme.desc: In the second installment of Louis Chais famous novel, Wei Xiao Bao is trapped again between his responsibilities to the country or takes side to the anti-Qing movement. (在路易·查伊著名小说的第二部中,小再次陷入国家责任的困境,或者站在反清运动的边缘.)

programme.title: Oversteer ((速战人生))
programme.desc: Feng defies his father and leaves home to pursue his dream of becoming an auto mechanic. Along the way, he unexpectedly finds himself drawn into the thrilling world of car racing. (不愿意去做汽车机械师,他却不想到自己会被引入赛车运动的激动人心世界.)

programme.title: Smashing Frank ((捣破法兰克))
programme.desc: After a jewelry store heist, the young thieves left behind a graffiti tag that reads FRANK, sparking public curiosity about their motives. What message are they trying to convey? (那些年轻的盗窃者在珠宝商店抢劫后,留下了一个写 FRANK 的涂标签,引起了人们对他们的动机的好奇.)

programme.title: Ready or Knot ((不日成婚))
programme.desc: A couple who first meet at a wedding have been together for five years, question the institution of marriage from opposing viewpoints. Should marriage always be the next step.? (一对夫妇在婚礼上第一次见面,已经在一起五年,从不同的角度来看,他们质疑婚姻的立场.)

programme.title: Triad ((三生花))
programme.desc: Set in the 90s during the Hong Kong handover, this drama depicts how a bookworm rises to become a formidable leader in the triads. (这部剧描述一头书呆虫如何升起成为三合会的强大领袖。)

programme.title: Its a Wonderful Life ((好运到))
programme.desc: Yam Tai Foon, a wealthy man is unhappy with his sons failed marriage and Kwais dream of being a comic artist. He pins hopes on his daughter, On, but she returns from France with wild Ruberto. (泰,一个富人不满意他的儿子失败的婚姻,克瓦伊梦想成为漫画家.他希望他的女儿,安,但她从法国返回与野蛮的鲁伯托.)

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident ((生きてみたいもう一度 新宿バス放火事件))
programme.desc: A simple Chinese immigrant wages a perilous war against one of the most powerful criminal organizations on the planet, in this sprawling action drama (一场简单的中国移民工资 一场针对这个世界上最强大的犯罪组织之一的 危险的战争 在这场无休无止的行动中)

programme.title: YOLO ((乐活姐妹：怪诞冒险))
programme.desc: After years of self-neglect, Le Ying decides to embrace life anew. Meeting a boxing coach sparks her desire for a fresh start. Despite the challenges ahead, she embarks on a transformative journey. (经过多年的自我忽视,决定重新接受生活.遇到拳击教练,她渴望重新开始.)

programme.title: In Broad Daylight ((盲人杀妻记))
programme.desc: Based on a true event of a news investigative unit receiving a tip-off about abuse in a care home for elderly and disabled. Reporter Kay goes undercover to unveil the cruel truth in broad daylight. (根据一个新闻调查部门在老人和残疾人养老院遭受虐待的真实事件,)

programme.title: Back To The Past ((寻秦记))
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lived in seclusion for 20 years until a time traveller returned to rewrite history, forcing them to defend the Qin dynasty and fate itself. (在帮助英正团结中国之后,洪小龙在隔离中生活了20年,直到旅行者返回重写历史,迫使他们保卫秦朝和命运。)

programme.title: Vital Signs ((生死征兆))
programme.desc: Paramedic Wang partners with Ma after being assigned to a new station. Though he clashes with Mas unconventional methods, Wang soon rediscovers the true mission of a paramedic - saving every life. (医护人员王在被派往新站后与马合作.虽然他与马的不传统方法发生冲突,但王很快重新发现了医护人员的真正使命 - - 拯救每一个生命.)

programme.title: Cold War ((冷战风云录))
programme.desc: Winner of 9 awards at the 32nd Hong Kong Film Awards! When a police van is hijacked, Deputy Commissioner M.B Lee launches a rescue operation codenamed Cold War. (获第32届香港电影奖9项奖项的获奖者!)

programme.title: Rachael Rays Holidays Ep05 (雷切尔雷斯假期 Ep05)

programme.title: Rachael Rays Holidays Ep06 (瑞秋雷斯假期 Ep06)

programme.title: New Trial ((法律与秩序：陪审团))
programme.desc: A lawyer in debt finds new meaning to his job when hes enlisted by a young man to clear his name after spending 10 years in prison for a crime he did not commit. (一个债务律师在一个年轻人招募他,)

programme.title: TAEYONG: Ty Track in Cinemas ((泰容：TY Track 大电影))
programme.desc: Taeyong is the first NCT member to make a solo debut. He released a mini album and held a 2-day concert. Witness his outstanding performance and take a closer look at him behind the stage. (Taiyong是全国技术中心第一位独奏会成员。 他发行了一张迷你专辑,并举行了为期两天的音乐会。 他见证了自己的杰出表现,并仔细观察了幕后情况。)

programme.title: 71: Into the Fire ((向着炮火))
programme.desc: 71 student-soldiers fight an impossible war against the elite 766 Commando Brigade and turn the tide of the Korean War. (七十一名学生士兵与精英766指挥旅进行了不可能的战争,)

programme.title: Joseon Chefs ((需云杂方))
programme.desc: A nobleman who has passed the national civil service exam meets the self-proclaimed best chef in Joseon, falls into the world of gourmet food, and sets out to find the life he truly wants. (一位通过国家公务员考试的贵族遇到了自称为子最好的厨师,)

programme.title: Harbin (哈尔滨)
programme.desc: In 1908, Ahn Jung-geun and Korean independence fighters win against Japanese army. A year later, they head to Harbin as the Japanese statesman Uto Hirobumi is going for negotiation... (1908年,安军和韩国独立战士赢得了日本军队.一年后,他们前往哈尔,)

programme.title: Room No. 7 ((7号室))
programme.desc: Doo-sik, a failing DVD room owner, and Tae-jung, a debt-ridden student, each hide some secrets in Room No. 7 of the store, sparking a darkly comic clash of secrets and survival. (杜,一个失败的DVD房主,和泰,一个债务的学生,)

programme.title: Dragon Inn Part 1: the City of Sadness ((龙屡阁：无情都市))
programme.desc: Dragon Inn is a Chinese restaurant that also serves as a safe house for a revenge team. A murder case arises, and the victim turns out to be a close friend of one of the members... (龙酒店是一个中国餐厅,也是报复团队的安全所.)

programme.title: Villain Widow ((二楼的恶人))
programme.desc: Widow Yeon-ju rents out the second floor of her home to a novelist. The neighbors suspect the novelists true identity as he spends an inordinate time whenever hes left home alone... (遗妇朱租了她的第二楼给一位小说家.)

programme.title: The Assassin ((绝命杀手))
programme.desc: Swordsman Lee Nan hides in a village to escape from his enemies. There, he witnessed atrocities and people are desperate for help. The killer buried in his heart finally makes his appearance. (剑士李南躲在一个村庄逃离他的敌人.在那里,他见证了残忍的行为,人们绝望寻求帮助.)

programme.title: Its Okay! ((没事))
programme.desc: In-young loses her mother in an accident and is kicked out by the landlord. Her chief choreographer has no choice but to bring her home. Facing adversity, the two gradually become closer. (在一场事故中失去了母亲,房东把她赶出去.她的主编编舞员别无选择,只能带她回家.面对逆境,他们逐渐变得更亲密.)

programme.title: Cold Eyes (寒冷的眼睛)
programme.desc: Yoon-joo, a rookie detective, joins a crime unit specialises in surveillance activities of high-profile criminals. They work together and track down a dangerous robber and his crew. (-朱,一个新生侦探,加入一个专门监视高调犯罪分子的犯罪单位.)

programme.title: Decision to Leave ((分手的决心))
programme.desc: When detective Hae-Joon investigates the death of a man who fell from a mountaintop and meets his wife Seo-rae, he starts to suspect her at the same time that he begins feeling an attraction to her. (当侦探 Hae-Joon调查从山顶下跌的男子死亡, 遇见他的妻子 Seo-rae, 他开始怀疑她,)

programme.title: Confidential Assignment 2: International ((共助2：国际))
programme.desc: N. Korea detective returns for another secret mission. Despite having different underlying motives, 3 countries join forces to bring down an international crime organization. (尽管有不同的动机,三国团结起来摧毁国际犯罪组织.)

programme.title: The Devils Deal ((The 金融恶魔 Deal))
programme.desc: A national assembly candidate, a hidden politics powerhouse and a gangster rivals for a top secret documet that will shake the nations core. (一个国民议会候选人,一个隐藏的政治强权 和一个黑帮对手 为了一个最高机密的)

programme.desc: When Andy loses his gizmo and gets lost in the dark, a friendly velociraptor comes to his aid.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Mud
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Cloud Kitchen, where Patch is busy with the Playtimers making a tasty treat called Munchy Muddy Meadows.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Ambition Badge
programme.desc: Duggee masters his ambition of building a model of the Clubhouse out of sticks. This encourages the Squirrels to think of their own ambitions, and how they can achieve them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Accessory Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels see Duggee accessorising his tie and want to learn how to do it themselves. All of the Squirrels accessorise an item and showcase their goods.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Mountain Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels need to rescue Enid when they see her at the top of the Mighty Sugar Bun Mountain.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Big Ben, England
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are on a mission to get Big Ben back to the Elizabeth Tower in time for it to chime at midnight! To the Vroomster!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch supersizes a fierce Komodo dragon, the Go Jetters must find the sizeray to fix the glitch.

programme.title: Thomas Friends S23 - Out of Site
programme.desc: Brenda learns that it is important to work as a team and not just care about her own jobs.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Tummy Talk
programme.desc: When Sarah forgets her sandwich, her rumbling tummy inadvertently starts a conversation.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Moons Exhibition
programme.desc: A trip to the art gallery unexpectedly helps Duck with the hunt for his lost toy Rhino.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Wonder Vole
programme.desc: Benjamin cant find his favourite toy, Wonder Vole anywhere. Stanley suggests they retrace his steps but have no luck. Maybe Wonder Vole Pyjamas will help Benjamin feel brave.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Treat
programme.desc: Stanleys friends throw him a birthday party. No work for Stan today. Cynthia and Jose take a call from Amare, her tractor is stuck in the mud. Soon, so are all Stanleys vehicles.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Dont Like Bananas
programme.desc: From broccoli soup to cheeseburgers and blue cheese, the funny animals chat about the best and worst things to eat.

programme.title: JoJo Gran Gran S03 - Its Time for a Surprise
programme.desc: JoJo, Gran Gran and Panda are helping Cynthia in her garden - JoJo loves how tall the sunflowers are. Cynthia gives JoJo a present of some sunflower seeds - JoJo can keep them ready to plant and grow more sunflowers next year. When she gets home, JoJo decides it would be nice to give Cynthia a surprise, but what can she give her? Its time for a Gran Gran plan as JoJo and Gran Gran work out what C

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Wild Girls
programme.desc: Coco wants to play Wild Girls with Indy, but Chloe wants her to play another game.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - TV Shop
programme.desc: At the chemist, Bluey and Bingo have fun playing with the CCTV screens.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Slide
programme.desc: Bingo and Lila are excited to play on their new waterslide.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Face Painting Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but cant find him. Instead, they find someone they think is Enid, only much too big... Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid! Of course, the Squirrels want their faces painted too, so Duggee sets to it.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Carrot Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring Duggees crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.

programme.title: Hey Duggees Squirrel Club S01 - Animals
programme.desc: The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Avenue of the Baobabs, Madagascar
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch tries his hand at stunt flying, but the Grimbots are unimpressed, giving him a unanimous thumbs down. He tries again, but its one loop-the-loop too much for poor old Grim HQ and it crash-lands in the branches of a baobab tree. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters enjoy the peaceful nighttime views of the Avenue of the Baobabs in Madagascar - a stand of trees known as the upside down tree

programme.title: Roots Fruits S01 - Carrot
programme.desc: Carrot sings about being trendy.

programme.title: Roots Fruits S01 - Watermelon
programme.desc: Watermelon performs a body tap routine.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Sweetieland Saga
programme.desc: Evil Pea cheats Chilli out of winning floofy teddies at a funfair made from sweets, so Supertato and the Veggies must get the teddies back before its too late!

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during Chinas early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chens past insult.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hongs enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brothers death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular Venom Lo Meng.

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his fathers death. He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Longs wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock n roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of scaffolding kung fu.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parents consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu Da Jiang, a naive young man, is betrayed and hunted by his sworn brothers after a gold robbery goes wrong. Surviving against the odds, he gains the favour of a gang leader and embarks on a path of revenge with bodyguard Jin Yan. As rival gangs clash and feelings emerge, a violent underworld showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy House of 72 tenants, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with The Five Venoms actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bi

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: Heads For Sale
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dongs songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the mens help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: Young Bao Tong witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by a vicious villain. A large eagle tattoo on Baos chest was spotted by the killer as he escapes. Can Bao escape from the killer?

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Mighty One
programme.desc: Lung seeks five volumes of a renowned Kung Fu manual to gain invincibility. When he believes a martial arts school master possesses the volumes, he kills him and his daughter but leaves behind a young brother and sister. Years later, Lung loses two volumes and starts another bloody hunt but each attempt is interrupted by two mysterious warriors...

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber 1977
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his fathers martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hungs passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lus disciple.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Mans matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuks pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk an

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laikas mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Mins friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Mins death.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kongs brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous Gang Trio is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three Rob-B-Hood must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xins ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the students family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bos magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: Its an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wifes rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. Its one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Final Justice 1988
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob bosss collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the citys patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Ministers daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxis concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsus funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Maybe Its Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchants mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find The Sutra of 42 Chapters. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: 卧底娇娃 Pretty Dangerous
programme.desc: 新型毒品粉精灵在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组三人分别擅长推理武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力故事融合卧底动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动As a new drug Pink Spirit spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.title: Aisha

programme.desc: 第5集n何泳芍 冒雨欣赏净土之滨海鲜市场抵食鱼生n播出日期：2026-05-14n泳芍冒雨启程，登上岩手县三陆铁道的谷湾线来到恋爱车站，她敲响幸福之钟，并忆起学生年代的甜蜜恋事nn受天雨影响，泳芍未能尽览名胜净土之滨的美景，更一度被海鸟包围脱身后前往附近餐厅用膳，幸福地大啖瓶丼鱼生饭她再乘船出海探勘青之洞窟，洞内海水呈现梦幻的翡翠色泽！nn回到宫古站，泳芍走进海鲜市场觅食手掌般巨大的在地生蚝，不需二十港元就有交易再深入土产商店买手信，还发掘到有趣的铁道周边商品.

programme.title: 娱乐头条 EXTRA
programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报导艺人最新动态剧集和电影宣传演唱会精华颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌影视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息.

programme.title: 晚间新闻 News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港两岸国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 杀人无数的刽子手叶常绿黄德斌为保护恩公的媳妇阮素心姚子羚顺利产子，将素心安顿在京城享负盛名的稳婆花蕊红邵美琪家中，因而遇上离奇命案，常绿竟以其鬼头刀救活了一条小生命，谁料这名来历不明的男婴令常绿和蕊红无故卷入朝廷的政治漩涡，一冷一热的配搭化解了一次又一次的危机，两人在患难中渐生情愫；另边厢，一对同在妓院长大的小情侣赤知秋杨明和祝小满龚嘉欣来到蕊红家，苦苦哀求常绿收知秋为刽子手的学徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脱受刑，常绿迟疑不决，一名神秘的彩戏师司马丑陈山聪出现，令各人关系陷入错综复杂，男婴身分之谜更因而被逐步揭开，但同时敲起了死神的丧钟.

programme.title: 兄弟 Fist Fight
programme.desc: 来自英国的保镖主管夏天行杨明，到港后奉命保护网络教主张非凡王浩信，顺道寻觅身世线索非凡行事张狂，还藉举办拳赛掩护窃密黑客赴港，期间屡遇险境麻烦，幸得天行一一化解事件引来火爆刑警何铁男伍允龙关注，决心全力追查原来铁男曾因一时冲动犯下不可告人的过失，性格亦渐走偏锋拳赛同时激发三人的好战天性，他们又逐渐发现彼此拥有相同的感应能力，藉以互助互救而三人背后的隐密连系，更牵涉逾二十年前的金融风暴之战.

programme.title: 巨轮 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 乔天生（陈展鹏饰）和罗威信（萧正楠饰）是同母异父的亲兄弟，因为命运令他们不单分开在香港和澳门两地，更令他们尝尽剧变历史中的两极冲突 母亲周玉梅（李司棋饰）带着小儿子威信在澳门当黑市居民，威信凭着努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮饰）与龙飞（阮兆祥饰）的相助，历尽艰辛，克服挑战，最终踏上成功之路独自在港自食其力的天生却改走快捷方式，联结黑道古惑仔姜勇（张继聪饰），与富家女发生关系，令女友卓静（钟嘉欣饰）伤心欲绝，最终落得人财两空 本是唇齿相依的手足情，经历时代巨轮的洗礼，前境变幻莫测，二人愈走愈远，但一个信念深植在他们相连的血脉里，纵然考验再苦再难，终在一条又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 妳不是她 Youre Just Not Her
programme.desc: 食品公司销售经理林信丁子朗饰时装店老板夏莉冯盈盈饰同居多时，爱情渐变平淡，两人对将来也存在分歧情侣间日积月累的矛盾不满一发不可收拾，林信夏莉爆发激烈争吵下引致车祸经历生死一剎后，踏实贤淑的夏莉变得热情率性，事事以林信为中心，甚至介入其圈子，为林信的姊姊林善车婉婉饰上司麦美娜姚嘉妮饰竞敌骆伟滔张颕康饰好兄弟穆家杰马贯东饰和区文黄庭锋饰带来巨大冲击！林信纵跟夏莉重拾初相识的浪漫与情愫，但眼前的她犹如判若两人，林信不禁思疑对方还是否真爱？.

programme.desc: 来自英国的保镖主管夏天行杨明，到港后奉命保护网络教主张非凡王浩信，顺道寻觅身世线索非凡行事张狂，还藉举办拳赛掩护窃密黑客赴港，期间屡遇险境麻烦，幸得天行一一化解事件引来火爆刑警何铁男伍允龙关注，决心全力追查原来铁男曾因一时冲动犯下不可告人的过失，性格亦渐走偏锋拳赛同时激发三人的好战天性，他们又逐渐发现彼此拥有相同的感应能力，藉以互助互救而三人背后的隐密连系，更牵涉逾二十年前的金融风暴之战.

programme.title: 巨轮 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 乔天生（陈展鹏饰）和罗威信（萧正楠饰）是同母异父的亲兄弟，因为命运令他们不单分开在香港和澳门两地，更令他们尝尽剧变历史中的两极冲突 母亲周玉梅（李司棋饰）带着小儿子威信在澳门当黑市居民，威信凭着努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮饰）与龙飞（阮兆祥饰）的相助，历尽艰辛，克服挑战，最终踏上成功之路独自在港自食其力的天生却改走快捷方式，联结黑道古惑仔姜勇（张继聪饰），与富家女发生关系，令女友卓静（钟嘉欣饰）伤心欲绝，最终落得人财两空 本是唇齿相依的手足情，经历时代巨轮的洗礼，前境变幻莫测，二人愈走愈远，但一个信念深植在他们相连的血脉里，纵然考验再苦再难，终在一条又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 妳不是她 Youre Just Not Her
programme.desc: 食品公司销售经理林信丁子朗饰时装店老板夏莉冯盈盈饰同居多时，爱情渐变平淡，两人对将来也存在分歧情侣间日积月累的矛盾不满一发不可收拾，林信夏莉爆发激烈争吵下引致车祸经历生死一剎后，踏实贤淑的夏莉变得热情率性，事事以林信为中心，甚至介入其圈子，为林信的姊姊林善车婉婉饰上司麦美娜姚嘉妮饰竞敌骆伟滔张颕康饰好兄弟穆家杰马贯东饰和区文黄庭锋饰带来巨大冲击！林信纵跟夏莉重拾初相识的浪漫与情愫，但眼前的她犹如判若两人，林信不禁思疑对方还是否真爱？.

programme.desc: 乔天生（陈展鹏饰）和罗威信（萧正楠饰）是同母异父的亲兄弟，因为命运令他们不单分开在香港和澳门两地，更令他们尝尽剧变历史中的两极冲突 母亲周玉梅（李司棋饰）带着小儿子威信在澳门当黑市居民，威信凭着努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮饰）与龙飞（阮兆祥饰）的相助，历尽艰辛，克服挑战，最终踏上成功之路独自在港自食其力的天生却改走快捷方式，联结黑道古惑仔姜勇（张继聪饰），与富家女发生关系，令女友卓静（钟嘉欣饰）伤心欲绝，最终落得人财两空 本是唇齿相依的手足情，经历时代巨轮的洗礼，前境变幻莫测，二人愈走愈远，但一个信念深植在他们相连的血脉里，纵然考验再苦再难，终在一条又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 妳不是她 Youre Just Not Her
programme.desc: 食品公司销售经理林信丁子朗饰时装店老板夏莉冯盈盈饰同居多时，爱情渐变平淡，两人对将来也存在分歧情侣间日积月累的矛盾不满一发不可收拾，林信夏莉爆发激烈争吵下引致车祸经历生死一剎后，踏实贤淑的夏莉变得热情率性，事事以林信为中心，甚至介入其圈子，为林信的姊姊林善车婉婉饰上司麦美娜姚嘉妮饰竞敌骆伟滔张颕康饰好兄弟穆家杰马贯东饰和区文黄庭锋饰带来巨大冲击！林信纵跟夏莉重拾初相识的浪漫与情愫，但眼前的她犹如判若两人，林信不禁思疑对方还是否真爱？.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 杀人无数的刽子手叶常绿黄德斌为保护恩公的媳妇阮素心姚子羚顺利产子，将素心安顿在京城享负盛名的稳婆花蕊红邵美琪家中，因而遇上离奇命案，常绿竟以其鬼头刀救活了一条小生命，谁料这名来历不明的男婴令常绿和蕊红无故卷入朝廷的政治漩涡，一冷一热的配搭化解了一次又一次的危机，两人在患难中渐生情愫；另边厢，一对同在妓院长大的小情侣赤知秋杨明和祝小满龚嘉欣来到蕊红家，苦苦哀求常绿收知秋为刽子手的学徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脱受刑，常绿迟疑不决，一名神秘的彩戏师司马丑陈山聪出现，令各人关系陷入错综复杂，男婴身分之谜更因而被逐步揭开，但同时敲起了死神的丧钟.

programme.desc: Blondie in Ancient Time mengisahkan seorang gadis berambut perang bernama Blondie yang secara misteri terperangkap di zaman purba akibat kejadian luar biasa. Terasing di dunia yang asing dengan adat, bahasa, dan kuasa politik yang kejam, Blondie terpaksa menyesuaikan diri demi kelangsungan hidup. Dengan kebijaksanaan, keberanian, dan hati yang tulus, dia perlahan-lahan memenangi kepercayaan penduduk tempatan serta menarik perhatian seorang pahlawan bangsawan yang berjiwa mulia. Namun, di sebalik percintaan yang berputik, Blondie terjebak dalam konflik istana, pengkhianatan, dan perebutan kuasa yang mengancam nyawanya. Drama ini memaparkan perjalanan Blondie mencari identiti, cinta sejati, dan jalan untuk menentukan sama ada dia harus kembali ke dunianya atau kekal mengubah takdir di zaman purba.

Terasing di dunia yang asing dengan adat, bahasa, dan kuasa politik yang kejam, Blondie terpaksa menyesuaikan diri demi kelangsungan hidup. Dengan kebijaksanaan, keberanian, dan hati yang tulus, dia perlahan-lahan memenangi kepercayaan penduduk tempatan serta menarik perhatian seorang pahlawan bangsawan yang berjiwa mulia. Namun, di sebalik percintaan yang berputik, Blondie terjebak dalam konflik istana, pengkhianatan, dan perebutan kuasa yang mengancam nyawanya. Drama ini memaparkan perjalanan Blondie mencari identiti, cinta sejati, dan jalan untuk menentukan sama ada dia harus kembali ke dunianya atau kekal mengubah takdir di zaman purba.

programme.title: Nasi Kerabu Mek Bunga
programme.desc: Nasi Kerabu Mek Bunga mengisahkan dua sahabat baik dan ibu tunggal berniaga dan memperjuangkan makanan tradisional iaitu Nasi Kerabu. Siti Zubedah lebih di kenali sebagai Mek berketurunan melayu berkawan rapat dengan Bunga Kim Fai berketurunan cina. Bunga dalam bahasa cina iaitu Fai. Mereka berkawan rapat sejak dari kecil lagi.

programme.title: Charlie And The Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Seorang budak lelaki miskin bernama Charlie Bucket tinggal bersama keluarganya di sebuah rumah usang. Hidup mereka susah, tetapi mereka bahagia. Suatu hari, Willy Wonka, pemilik kilang coklat terkenal, mengumumkan pertandingan mencari lima tiket emas tersembunyi di dalam coklat buatannya. Charlie berjaya menemui salah satu tiket tersebut dan mendapat peluang menyertai lawatan eksklusif ke dalam kilang coklat Wonka bersama empat kanak-kanak lain yang manja, tamak, dan ego.Dalam kilang tersebut, pelbagai keajaiban dan ujian menanti mereka. Seorang demi seorang kanak-kanak tersebut mendapat pengajaran akibat sikap buruk mereka, manakala Charlie kekal jujur dan baik hati. Akhirnya, Charlie mendapati lawatan itu lebih dari sekadar pengembaraan biasa,ia adalah ujian untuk mencari pewaris sebenar empayar coklat Willy Wonka.

programme.desc: Sejak belajar mengaji dengan Tok Sintok dan berjaya menghafal pelbagai surah pendek, Azhan dan Badrul sedikit sebanyak mula berubah. Mereka sudah rajin solat dan mula bangun solat Subuh walaupun selama ini tak pernah solat Subuh. Mereka tetap bekerja sebagai samseng tarik kereta. Tetapi, mereka rasa bersalah menjadi samseng dan terasa tak selesa. Mereka terpaksa juga kerja untuk teruskan kehidupan dan berhasrat cari kerja lain. Mereka senyap-senyap interview kerja lain tapi gaji pula kecil.

programme.title: Podcast Jejak Merdeka

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan cool di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: UsopWilchaMehghonjangMakhlukMuzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan cool di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. programme.title: Adnan Sempit Sawadikap
programme.desc: mengisahkan Adnan Shaheizy Sam yang lucu, bersama isteri dan anaknya, memulakan perjalanan ke Thailand bersama sahabat baik mereka, Bobby dan Wawa, di mana pelbagai lagi pengembaraan menanti.

programme.title: Adnan Sempit Generasi Gig
programme.desc: Selepas menyelamatkan Nadia Afifah Nasir, seorang wanita moden yang telah lama diminatinya, Adnan Aiman Tino, seorang penghantar makanan, mula jatuh cinta tanpa menyedari bahawa dia mungkin terperangkap dalam rancangan tersembunyi wanita tersebut.

programme.title: Kau Langit Aku Laut
programme.desc: Kau Langit Aku Laut mengisahkan pasangan kekasih yang mempunyai banyak perbezaan dan sering bergaduh. Mereka cuba pertahankan hubungan walaupun banyak cabaran dan salah faham.

programme.title: By My Side
programme.desc: Sejak kecil, Faye dan Ben membesar bersama di Subang Jaya dan akhirnya jatuh cinta serta menjalinkan hubungan. Namun hubungan mereka diuji apabila Ben merancang untuk ke Australia, memaksa Faye belajar menghadapi cinta jarak jauh dan kehidupan tanpa dia.

programme.title: La Tahzan
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Viona, seorang wanita Indonesia yang tinggal di Jepun dan bekerja sebagai pengurus rumah kepada keluarga Muslim. Kehidupannya berubah apabila dia bertemu dengan Hasan, seorang lelaki yang menyimpan kisah silam dan rahsia dalam perkahwinannya. Konflik timbul apabila cinta, kepercayaan dan pengorbanan diuji, membawa Viona kepada perjalanan memahami makna kesabaran, keikhlasan dan ketentuan Tuhan.

programme.title: Hello Goodbye
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Indra dan Dara, pasangan muda yang berdepan cabaran dalam hubungan mereka apabila impian, jarak dan masalah peribadi mula menguji kekuatan cinta mereka. Kisah ini mengetengahkan tentang pengorbanan, keluarga, harapan serta erti melepaskan seseorang yang disayangi demi kebahagiaan masing-masing.

programme.title: 29 Februari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Budi, seorang lelaki yang dilahirkan pada 29 Februari 1896 dan hanya meningkat usia setiap empat tahun sekali. Sepanjang hayatnya, Budi menyaksikan pelbagai perubahan zaman dan kehilangan insan tersayang, sehinggalah dia bertemu cinta sejatinya, Lily, yang mengubah perjalanan hidupnya.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia

programme.title: Rock 4 - Rockers Never Dai
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Dio, bekas anggota kumpulan rock legenda Rimba Bara, yang terjaga selepas bertahun-tahun koma akibat kemalangan. Berdepan dengan perubahan zaman dan industri muzik yang semakin berubah, Dio berusaha menghidupkan kembali legasi Rimba Bara dengan menubuhkan kumpulan baharu, Rimba Bara 2, bersama barisan pemuzik muda. Namun, perjalanan mereka untuk mengembalikan kegemilangan muzik rock penuh dengan cabaran dan persaingan

programme.title: Srimulat Hidup Memang Komedi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan perjalanan awal kumpulan komedi legenda Indonesia, Srimulat, yang berhijrah dari Solo ke Jakarta untuk mengejar impian mencipta nama. Dalam usaha mencapai kejayaan, mereka berdepan pelbagai cabaran, pengorbanan dan konflik, namun terus menghiburkan penonton dengan jenaka dan semangat yang tidak pernah luntur.

Saksikan malam penuh gemilang yang menyatukan muzik dan budaya, khas dipersembahkan bagi menyemarakkan semangat Cinta Indonesia.

programme.title: Tertawan Hati
programme.desc: Alya dan Alyssa ialah pasangan kembar yang terpisah sejak lahir. Selepas 25 tahun, takdir menemukan mereka semula, dan mereka terkejut melihat wajah yang begitu seiras. Pertemuan itu merapatkan hubungan mereka, namun tanpa disedari pelbagai rahsia dan konflik mula terbongkar, mengubah kehidupan kedua-duanya.

programme.title: Siapa Takut Orang Ketiga
programme.desc: Kimi tiba di Swiss untuk memulakan hidup barunya dan di sana dia berkenalan dengan William, seorang pelajar Indonesia yang sedang menyelesaikan pengajiannya. William membantu Kimi mendapatkan pekerjaan. Samuel, sahabat Kimi di Indonesia, merasakan Kimi semakin dekat dengan William. Namun, Kimi menyangkal perkara itu. Hakikatnya, Kimi telah menyimpan perasaan kepada Samuel sejak lama.

programme.title: Jerit Malam Berujung Cinta
programme.desc: Karina, seorang gadis yang menyertai kelab pencinta alam telah mengalami kejadian misteri semasa aktiviti malam di hutan. Dia telah bertemu dengan Raka, seorang lelaki yang menyimpan rahsia gelap. Pelbagai peristiwa aneh dan menyeramkan mula berlaku, menguji keberanian dan kepercayaan mereka. Dalam usaha untuk menyelamatkan diri, mereka menemui cinta.

programme.title: Cinta Sedalam Rindu
programme.desc: Aluna menyangka takdirnya hanyalah sebagai anak kepada seorang pembantu rumah yang terpaksa mengorbankan cintanya demi Felicia, anak majikannya. Namun, apabila rahsia dari masa lalunya terbongkar, seluruh hidup mereka berubah sama sekali.

programme.title: Di Antara Dua Cinta
programme.desc: Pada hari ulang tahun perkahwinan Shafira dan Rafael yang ke-2, Shafira dikejutkan dengan berita bahawa Rafael telah terlibat dalam satu kemalangan, dan jasadnya tidak ditemui. Beberapa tahun berlalu, Rafael akhirnya disahkan meninggal dunia. Shafira kemudian membuat keputusan untuk berkahwin semula dengan Julian. Namun, di puncak kebahagiaan perkahwinan mereka, Rafael tiba-tiba muncul kembali.

programme.desc: Dokumentari separa realiti yang meneroka Minang, sebuah wilayah di Indonesia yang terkenal sebagai Tanah Para Pedagang.

programme.title: Aku Terancam Karena Saksi Pengkhianatan
programme.desc: Alika Cerelia Raissa dan Rezki Ichal Muhammad mula menerima gangguan misteri selepas menjadi saksi kepada hubungan mencurigakan antara Lasti Larassati Kusnandar dan Ringga Rendy Kusdiana. Ketika mereka cuba membongkar kebenaran, Adam Rizal Akbar yang mengalami masalah saraf sehingga tidak dapat berjalan, turut menyimpan sesuatu yang mengejutkan. Pelbagai rahsia mula terbongkar apabila mereka semakin hampir dengan kebenaran.

programme.title: DAcademy 7 Mega Konser: Rhomantika Irama
programme.desc: Sebuah persembahan muzik istimewa sebagai penghormatan kepada Raja Dangdut, Rhoma Irama. Konsert khas ini menampilkan alumni DAcademy 7 yang membawakan lagu-lagu malar segar dan irama ikonik beliau, sekali gus menghidupkan nostalgia dengan sentuhan baharu di pentas.

programme.title: Saleha
programme.desc: Saleha mengisahkan seorang gadis baik hati yang ditinggalkan oleh ayahnya dan dibesarkan oleh nenek. Selepas diculik dan kehilangan neneknya, dia dipersalahkan dan dihalau oleh keluarganya. Dengan semangat dan keimanan yang teguh, Saleha memulakan hidup baru di Jakarta sambil menyembunyikan penyakit serius.

programme.title: Makan Terooos
programme.desc: Jelajahi kekayaan masakan yang menampilkan rasa autentik. Sertai kami dalam pengembaraan rasa di seluruh Indonesia, hanya di Makan Terooos, di mana setiap hidangan memiliki kisahnya sendiri.

programme.title: Tertawan Hati
programme.desc: Alya dan Alyssa ialah pasangan kembar yang terpisah sejak lahir. Selepas 25 tahun, takdir menemukan mereka semula, dan mereka terkejut melihat wajah yang begitu seiras. Pertemuan itu merapatkan hubungan mereka, namun tanpa disedari pelbagai rahsia dan konflik mula terbongkar, mengubah kehidupan kedua-duanya.

programme.title: Cinta Buta Yang Membawa Petaka
programme.desc: Seorang wanita bernama Anggi yang terjebak dalam hubungan yang toksik dengan seorang lelaki bernama Hendrik. Oleh kerana cinta but, Anggi mengabaikan nasihat daripada keluarga dan rakan-rakannya dan akhirnya membawa penderitaan dan petaka dalam hidupnya.

programme.title: Superstar Junior
programme.desc: Superstar Junior Indonesia ialah pertandingan bakat kanak-kanak yang disiarkan di Mentari TV. Rancangan ini menampilkan peserta cilik dari seluruh negara yang menunjukkan bakat dalam nyanyian, tarian dan lakonan untuk memikat hati juri dan penonton.

programme.title: A MAN OF REASON ((保护者))
programme.desc: After being released from prison, a man learns that he has a daughter, thus wishes to leave the gangs and live an ordinary life. Yet the new leader of the gangs feels being betrayed... (一个男人从监狱中获释后,他发现他有一个女儿,因此希望离开帮派,)

programme.title: OMNISCIENT READER: THE PROPHECY ((全知读者视角))
programme.desc: Dok-ja is the only reader of an obscure web novel for 10 years. Suddenly, the apocalyptic world of the novel becomes reality. He and the novels omnipotent hero strive to save the world. (东贾是10年来唯一读过一个模糊的网络小说的读者.突然间,小说的末日世界成为现实.他和小说的全能英雄努力拯救世界.)

programme.title: PRETTY CRAZY ((容祖儿 PRETTY CRAZY 演唱会 嘉宾篇))
programme.desc: Gil-gu falls for his new neighbor, Sun-ji. She is sweet by day but appears uncanny at night. He later learns that there is a devil inside her and wants to unravel her curse. (吉尔古爱上了他的新邻居孙.她白天很甜,但夜晚看起来很奇怪.他后来发现她内心有魔鬼,想解开她的诅咒.)

programme.title: A TAXI DRIVER ((出租车司机艳遇记))
programme.desc: A widowed father and taxi driver takes a German reporter from Seoul to Gwangju to cover the 1980 uprising. (一个寡妇父亲和出租车司机将一位德国记者从首尔带到广州报道1980年起义.)

programme.title: LOVE RESET ((爱情重置))
programme.desc: A couple decide to divorce after two years of marriage. They revive a 30-day divorce settlement period from the court, but then they both lost memories after a car accident... (两年结婚后,一对夫妇决定离婚,他们恢复了30天的离婚和解期限,)

programme.title: THE PRESIDENTS BARBER ((孝子洞理发师))
programme.desc: A man and his family get tangled in decades of political chaos when he was appointed as the presidents personal barber. (一个人和他的家人陷入了几十年的政治混乱,)

programme.title: NEW TRIAL ((法律与秩序：陪审团))
programme.desc: A lawyer in debt finds new meaning to his job when hes enlisted by a young man to clear his name after spending 10 years in prison for a crime he did not commit. (一个债务律师在一个年轻人招募他,)

programme.title: TAEYONG: TY TRACK IN CINEMAS ((泰容：TY Track 大电影))
programme.desc: Taeyong is the first NCT member to make a solo debut. He released a mini album and held a 2-day concert. Witness his outstanding performance and take a closer look at him behind the stage. (Taiyong是全国技术中心第一位独奏会成员。 他发行了一张迷你专辑,并举行了为期两天的音乐会。 他见证了自己的杰出表现,并仔细观察了幕后情况。)

programme.title: 71: INTO THE FIRE ((向着炮火))
programme.desc: 71 student-soldiers fight an impossible war against the elite 766 Commando Brigade and turn the tide of the Korean War. (七十一名学生士兵与精英766指挥旅进行了不可能的战争,)

programme.title: JOSEON CHEFS ((需云杂方))
programme.desc: A nobleman who has passed the national civil service exam meets the self-proclaimed best chef in Joseon, falls into the world of gourmet food, and sets out to find the life he truly wants. (一位通过国家公务员考试的贵族遇到了自称为子最好的厨师,)

programme.title: HARBIN (哈本)
programme.desc: In 1908, Ahn Jung-geun and Korean independence fighters win against Japanese army. A year later, they head to Harbin as the Japanese statesman Uto Hirobumi is going for negotiation... (1908年,安军和韩国独立战士赢得了日本军队.一年后,他们前往哈尔,)

programme.title: ROOM NO. 7 ((7号室))
programme.desc: Doo-sik, a failing DVD room owner, and Tae-jung, a debt-ridden student, each hide some secrets in Room No. 7 of the store, sparking a darkly comic clash of secrets and survival. (杜,一个失败的DVD房主,和泰,一个债务的学生,)

programme.title: DRAGON INN PART 1: THE CITY OF SADNESS ((龙屡阁：无情都市))
programme.desc: Dragon Inn is a Chinese restaurant that also serves as a safe house for a revenge team. A murder case arises, and the victim turns out to be a close friend of one of the members... (龙酒店是一个中国餐厅,也是报复团队的安全所.)

programme.title: VILLAIN WIDOW ((二楼的恶人))
programme.desc: Widow Yeon-ju rents out the second floor of her home to a novelist. The neighbors suspect the novelists true identity as he spends an inordinate time whenever hes left home alone (寡妇延珠将她家二楼租给了一位小说家。 邻居怀疑小说家的真实身份,因为他独自离开家时花的时间过长。)

programme.title: THE ASSASSIN ((绝命杀手))
programme.desc: Swordsman Lee Nan hides in a village to escape from his enemies. There, he witnessed people are desperate for help and the killer buried in his heart finally makes his appearance. (剑客李南躲在村子里逃避敌人。在那里,他亲眼目睹人们急切地寻求帮助,而埋藏在他心底的凶手终于露面。)

programme.title: ITS OKAY! ((没事))
programme.desc: In-young loses her mother in an accident and is kicked out by the landlord. Her chief choreographer has no choice but to bring her home. Facing adversity, the two gradually become closer. (在一场事故中失去了母亲,房东把她赶出去.她的主编编舞员别无选择,只能带她回家.面对逆境,他们逐渐变得更亲密.)

programme.title: COLD EYES (寒冷的眼睛)
programme.desc: Yoon-joo, a rookie detective, joins a crime unit specialises in surveillance activities of high-profile criminals. They work together and track down a dangerous robber and his crew. (-朱,一个新生侦探,加入一个专门监视高调犯罪分子的犯罪单位.)

programme.title: DECISION TO LEAVE ((分手的决心))
programme.desc: When detective Hae-Joon investigates the death of a man who fell from a mountaintop and meets his wife Seo-rae, he starts to suspect her at the same time that he begins feeling an attraction to her. (当侦探 Hae-Joon调查从山顶下跌的男子死亡, 遇见他的妻子 Seo-rae, 他开始怀疑她,)

programme.title: CONFIDENTIAL ASSIGNMENT 2: INTERNATIONAL ((共助2：国际))
programme.desc: N. Korea detective returns for another secret mission. Despite having different underlying motives, 3 countries join forces to bring down an international crime organization. (尽管有不同的动机,三国团结起来摧毁国际犯罪组织.)

programme.title: THE DEVILS DEAL ((THE 金融恶魔 DEAL))
programme.desc: A national assembly candidate, a hidden politics powerhouse and a gangster rivals for a top secret document that will shake the nations core. (国会候选人、隐藏的政治强权、黑帮对手,)

programme.title: LOVE BARISTA ((爱情咖啡师))
programme.desc: Superstar Jun-woo is stranded in Vietnam with no passport and money. Barista Tao breaks his phone and offers him shelter. As their bond begins to blossom, scandals tear them apart... (大明星俊宇被困在越南,没有护照和钱。 陶达士打破电话,为他提供庇护。 随着他们的纽带开始开花,丑闻将他们撕裂...)

programme.title: NORYANG: DEADLY SEA ((露梁海战))
programme.desc: Based on the historical Battle of Noryang in 1598. A story of Yi Sun-Shins last battle during the Japanese invasions of Korea. (根据1598年北阳战役的历史故事. 故事讲述了日军在韩国入侵期间最后一次战斗的义孙欣.)

programme.desc: Actor Gu Bon-seung shows the warmth and purity of life in the village along the river, and presents how new history was made and became ones memory. (演员郭展示了河边村庄的生活的温暖和纯洁,)

programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights. (苏普在周一到周日播出,密切关注主要社会事件和有趣的故事,同时还报道了娱乐行业的最新更新,名人新闻,以及戏剧促销和幕后特色.今天 Breaking News 分类让观众了解最热门的故事.深入的特色部分探讨了公众关心的当前事件,社会和生计问题,采访相关专家以获取他们的见解.)

programme.title: Her Railway Trip (她的铁路旅行)
programme.desc: Japans railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname Tetsuko meaning railway girl. The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether youre a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, Tetsukos Lofty Mountain offers a romantic and surprising railway journey. (日本铁路世界千差万别,从风景山谷到海岸线。 每条火车的车窗都像一幅风景绘画,吸引了铁路爱好者。近年来,它也吸引了许多妇女,产生了一个独一无二的叫Tetsuko的绰号叫Tetsuko的火车女郎。这个由即将上台的女演员Ni Jiawen和He Yongsao牵头的节目,通过日本铁路旅行的魅力,让观众走上旅程。它不仅介绍铁路本身,还探索铁路横跨的地道和城市,展示铁路和城镇交织创造的独特景观。不管你是铁路爱好者还是观光者,都喜欢探索新的文化,Tetsukos Lofty山提供了一条浪漫和令人惊讶的铁路旅程。)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. programme.desc: Human beings are innately curious about the unknown. Some even believe that not everything in life can be explained solely by scientific or physical phenomena. Even when there appears to be an acceptable answer on the surface, it may not fully resolve all our questions. The production team of Shock Mystery has collected hundreds of strange and unusual cases from around the world, most of which cannot be explained from the perspectives commonly accepted by peopleunless supernatural phenomena truly exist in our world! This program will introduce you to incredible mysteries that not only existed in the past but still persist today! (人类天生好奇于未知. 有些人甚至认为生命中的一切都不能仅仅通过科学或物理现象来解释.即使表面上似乎有一个可接受的答案,它也许无法完全解决所有我们的问题. 震惊神秘的制作团队已经收集了来自世界各地的数百个奇怪和不寻常的案例,其中大多数无法从人们普遍接受的观点来解释,除非超自然现象真的存在于我们的世界!这个节目将向您介绍了不可思议的奥秘,不仅存在于过去,而且仍然存在于今天!)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. programme.title: Mrs. Revenge ((夫妻的博弈))
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness! (善良的心情的杭萨曼塔科患有某种终结性疾病,因为她只是在丈夫谢凯瓦伊乔纳森的暴政下存在.她发现丈夫和她唯一的朋友普恩苏特曼罗西塔·奎克发生了外遇,在争论时,她被推到道路上,并被车车车悲剧地撞击.然而,杭突然醒来,意识到一切似乎只是一个梦.但随着她的梦中的场景逐渐实现,她认为这是一个预见.为了重写命运,杭决心扭转她的梦中的不幸.杭不仅想摆脱那个丑和她的假朋友,而且还试图把两个人一起来,以便苏特曼能够接管她的不幸.她最终在梦中使用自己的梦想,并逐渐发展了幸福感,她和凯瑟琳一起)

programme.title: The Tang Mist ((大唐迷雾))

programme.title: Her Railway Trip (她的铁路旅行)
programme.desc: Japans railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname Tetsuko meaning railway girl. The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether youre a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, Tetsukos Lofty Mountain offers a romantic and surprising railway journey. (日本铁路世界千差万别,从风景山谷到海岸线。 每条火车的车窗都像一幅风景绘画,吸引了铁路爱好者。近年来,它也吸引了许多妇女,产生了一个独一无二的叫Tetsuko的绰号叫Tetsuko的火车女郎。这个由即将上台的女演员Ni Jiawen和He Yongsao牵头的节目,通过日本铁路旅行的魅力,让观众走上旅程。它不仅介绍铁路本身,还探索铁路横跨的地道和城市,展示铁路和城镇交织创造的独特景观。不管你是铁路爱好者还是观光者,都喜欢探索新的文化,Tetsukos Lofty山提供了一条浪漫和令人惊讶的铁路旅程。)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace.
