However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. programme.desc: Japans railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname Tetsuko meaning railway girl. The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether youre a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, Tetsukos Lofty Mountain offers a romantic and surprising railway journey. (日本铁路世界千差万别,从风景山谷到海岸线。 每条火车的车窗都像一幅风景绘画,吸引了铁路爱好者。近年来,它也吸引了许多妇女,产生了一个独一无二的叫Tetsuko的绰号叫Tetsuko的火车女郎。这个由即将上台的女演员Ni Jiawen和He Yongsao牵头的节目,通过日本铁路旅行的魅力,让观众走上旅程。它不仅介绍铁路本身,还探索铁路横跨的地道和城市,展示铁路和城镇交织创造的独特景观。不管你是铁路爱好者还是观光者,都喜欢探索新的文化,Tetsukos Lofty山提供了一条浪漫和令人惊讶的铁路旅程。)

programme.title: Gourmet Express ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors. (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.title: Vital Lifeline ((最强生命线))
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health. (城市居民往往经历着繁忙的生活和高度压力,这使他们更容易受到健康问题的影响。最强的生命线帮助你解开健康的秘密。首先,该方案在常见的城市疼痛问题上有四大系列,包括头痛、肩部和颈部疼痛、背部疼痛和联合疼痛。每集都邀请医疗专家解释这些病症的原因,以及物理治疗师和锻炼专家进行适当的锻炼。随着东西方医学结合的趋势日益增长,甚至美国游泳冠军迈克尔·菲尔普斯也使用杯式疗法来缓解疼痛。因此,每集都包括传统的中国医学诊断,辅之以针线、杯子和Sanfu草药补丁疗法等疗法,这些疗法在最热的夏季特别合适。此外,中国医药从业人员分享了营养汤的食谱,所有这些都有助于调节和改善你的健康。)

programme.title: Big Boys Club ((Big Boys Club兄弟幫 - 外星來客))
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience. (大男孩俱乐部是一款由一群亲密朋友Bob Lam,Oscar Leung,Derek Wong,Philip Fan和Alan Chan主办的青年谈话节目.在每个集中,歌手,演员或来自不同领域的客人都被邀请进行放松的面试,介绍了包括当前社会问题,流行文化和流行兴趣在内的广泛的主题.爱情,关系甚至同性关系等问题是不止讨论的主题.该节目邀请来自不同背景的客人探索爱情和关系,深入性别之间的动态.其他维度段有客人分享非凡的经验,如遇到鬼魂,UFO和奇怪事件,将兴奋的主题带到观众.)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: News At 18:30 Global View Whats On Today ((重轻参与的播客 Global View Whats On Today))
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30. (每天下午6点30分,Jade Channel报道了重要的当地,跨海峡和国际新闻.)

programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights. (苏普在周一到周日播出,密切关注主要社会事件和有趣的故事,同时还报道了娱乐行业的最新更新,名人新闻,以及戏剧促销和幕后特色.今天 Breaking News 分类让观众了解最热门的故事.深入的特色部分探讨了公众关心的当前事件,社会和生计问题,采访相关专家以获取他们的见解.)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge ((夫妻的博弈))
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness! (善良的心情的杭萨曼塔科患有某种终结性疾病,因为她只是在丈夫谢凯瓦伊乔纳森的暴政下存在.她发现丈夫和她唯一的朋友普恩苏特曼罗西塔·奎克发生了外遇,在争论时,她被推到道路上,并被车车车悲剧地撞击.然而,杭突然醒来,意识到一切似乎只是一个梦.但随着她的梦中的场景逐渐实现,她认为这是一个预见.为了重写命运,杭决心扭转她的梦中的不幸.杭不仅想摆脱那个丑和她的假朋友,而且还试图把两个人一起来,以便苏特曼能够接管她的不幸.她最终在梦中使用自己的梦想,并逐渐发展了幸福感,她和凯瑟琳一起)

programme.title: EXTRA ((E.T.外星人))
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kongs entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audienceensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment. programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.title: Break Up Club (打破俱乐部)
programme.desc: Joe is a 20-something slacker who only takes one thing seriously: his on-and-off girlfriend Flora. After their latest breakup, Joe goes to an audition for a documentary by director Barbara Wong. Handed a camera, Joe records his discovery of a magical website that reunites him with Flora at the price of breaking up his best friend and his girlfriend. However, despite the efficiency of the website, Joes refusal to change his immature ways and Floras attraction to a talented graffiti artist threatens to break them up once more. (Joe是个20多岁的懒鬼,他只认真对待一件事:他的在外的女朋友Flora。在他们最近的分手后,Joe去看了黄芭芭拉导演的纪录片试镜。他拿了摄像头,Joe记录了他发现一个神奇的网站,这个网站使他与Flora团聚,其代价是打碎了他最好的朋友和女友。然而,尽管网站的效率很高,但Joes拒绝改变他不成熟的方式,而Floras吸引一个有才华的涂鸦艺术家,这有可能再次瓦解他们。)

programme.title: No One Like Me ((乱马½))
programme.desc: Yang Qian Huan, the third disciple of the Imperial Astronomer, was once a golden boy. However, since the birth of Xu Qi An, his glory has waned. His relentless pursuit cannot defy a merciless truth: all has been foretold. Yet rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate. (帝国天文学家第三位门徒杨建万曾是金童。 然而,自徐琦安出生以来,他的荣耀已消逝。 他坚持不懈的追求不能违抗无情的真理:一切已早料而终。 Yang自倒台以来,却自欺欺人,自命不凡,拒绝顺从命运。)

programme.title: The Movie Emperor ((红毯先生))
programme.desc: Hong Kong megastar Lau Wai Chi aspires to win a film award. He teams up with director Lin Hao to make a film about rural China so as to win at the international film festival, and experiences local village life for the farmers role. This ends up in a series of hilarious events instead. (香港巨星Lau Wai Chi希望赢得电影奖。 他与导演Lin Hao合作制作一部关于中国农村的电影,以便在国际电影节上获胜,并体验当地乡村的生活,让农民扮演角色。 结果,这在一系列有趣的活动中出现。)

programme.title: True Love For Once in My Life ((浅浅岁月))
programme.desc: Sabrinas deep love for Andrew is shattered after his affair destroys their marriage, leaving her heartbroken. Years later, when Andrew is diagnosed with cancer, Sabrina chooses to return and care for her former husband despite the pain of the past. As old emotions resurface, she still believes true love comes only once in a lifetime. (桑比娜对安德鲁的深厚爱情在他的恋爱破坏了他们的婚姻后,导致她的心碎.多年后,当安德鲁被诊断患有癌症时,桑比娜选择回来照顾她的前丈夫,尽管过去的痛苦.随着旧情绪的复苏,她仍然相信真正的爱情只会在一生中出现一次.)

programme.title: Schemes in Antiques ((古董局中局))
programme.desc: Despite his familys expertise in ancient Chinese relics, Xu Yuan becomes an electronics shop owner to distance himself from his disgraced family. However, when an antique is to be returned to China, Xu Yuan uncovers an ancient mystery and soon embarks on a journey that can finally restore his familys reputation but may also cost him his life. (尽管徐元家族在古代中国遗迹中拥有丰富的经验,但徐元还是电子商场的业主,以便与他丢脸的家族保持距离。 然而,当古董被送回中国时,徐元发现了一个古老的谜题,并很快踏上一条旅程,最终可以恢复其家族的名誉,但也可能让他丧失生命。)

programme.title: Cape No. 7 ((海角七号))
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer tries to deliver seven old love letters attentioned to a Tomoko. As he falls in love with a young Japanese model also named Tomoko, he unravels their serendipitous connection. (一位台湾歌手试图向一个莫科传递七封古老的爱情信.当他爱上一个名叫莫科的年轻日本模特时,他发现了他们的偶然联系.)

programme.title: Marriage With A Liar ((婚前试爱))
programme.desc: Kiki and her boyfriend of seven years, Sean, are to be married in a week but both cheated on each other three days before the wedding. Faced with each of their perfect partners, Kiki and Sean ignore their responsibilities to each other and choose to go their separate ways (琪琪和她的7岁男友西恩将在一周内结婚,但婚前3天两人互欺骗。 面对他们每一个完美的伴侣,琪琪和肖恩忽略了他们彼此的责任,选择了各自的方式。)

programme.title: Relentless Fury ((赴汤蹈火))
programme.desc: Captain Lin Lang and his elite mercenary team are tasked with escorting a mysterious woman safely home. Bearing the highest bounty in dark web history, she draws assassins from across the globe. Among them is the notorious fugitive Ray. Now, Lin and his team must survive a deadly fight to complete their mission. (Lin Lang上尉和他的精英雇佣兵团队负责护送一个神秘女人安全回家。她拥有黑暗网络史上最高的赏金,从全球各地画出刺客。其中有臭名昭著的逃犯Ray。现在,Lin和他的团队必须挺过一场致命的战斗才能完成任务。)

programme.title: A Gilded Game ((猎金游戏))
programme.desc: Ambitious finance student Gao lands an internship as his friends family business prepares to go public in H.K. Under the mentorship of top analyst Zhang, his swift rise is soon undone by greed. After betraying Zhang for a rival, Gao puts his friends company in jeopardy. To redeem himself, he must seek help from Zhang to stop a hostile takeover. (高高明的金融野心学生高高明在其朋友的家族生意准备在H.K.公开的时候,当他的朋友家族生意准备在H.K.公开的时候,高高明就投身实习。 在高官分析师张明的引导下,他的迅速崛起很快因贪婪而倒闭。 高高明在背叛张氏竞争对手后,将朋友公司置于危险之中。 为了赎罪,他必须寻求张明的帮助以阻止敌对的接管。)

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood ((宝贝计划))
programme.desc: The infamous Gang Trio is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three Rob-B-Hood must put the baby safely back in his cradle. (臭名昭著的三驾马车被雇用绑架婴儿3000万。 当他们发现三驾马车打算抢夺赎金并杀害孩子时,他们把婴儿放在他们的翅膀下。 在被警察包围和黑帮追捕的情况下,三个Rob-B-Hood必须把婴儿安全地放回他的摇篮里。)

programme.title: Limbo ((丛林地狱))
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of brutal murders committed by a serial killer. Veteran detective Cham and rookie cop Will are assigned to the case. During the investigation, they encounter Wang Tao, who accidentally killed Chams wife. Seeking redemption, Wang assists them in tracking down the killer, but her involvement puts her in grave danger. (香港受到连环杀手一系列残忍谋杀的震撼。 退伍军人侦探Cham和新警察Will被指派负责此案。 在调查期间,他们遇到不小心杀害Cham Tao妻子的王涛。 寻求救赎,王氏协助他们追踪凶手,但她的参与使她处于严重危险之中。)

programme.title: Royal Tramp II ((鹿鼎记II：神龙教))
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from The Sutra of 42 Chapters. (龙族领袖龙二(Long Er)帮助吴将军推翻江西皇帝。然而,龙二被吴将军背叛,小宝营救了。结果,她将童贞和武术权授予小宝,让小宝与吴作战。 同时,小宝又巧妙地揭发了42章苏特拉的藏宝。)

programme.title: Oversteer ((速战人生))
programme.desc: Adapted from a true story, the film follows Feng, a determined young man who defies his father to pursue his dream of becoming an automotive mechanic. Alongside his childhood friend Yun, he embarks on a daring journey that unexpectedly plunges them into the exhilarating world of racing, sparking a passionate coming-of-age adventure. (这部电影从一个真实的故事改编而来,紧随冯。 冯是一位执着的年轻人,他挑战父亲追求成为汽车机械师的梦想。 他和他的童年朋友云一起,踏上了一场大胆的旅程,意外地将他们推入激动人心的赛车世界,引发了一场充满激情的即将到来的冒险。)

programme.title: Smashing Frank ((捣破法兰克))
programme.desc: Four young thieves wearing bunny masks pull off the heists targeting the rich. Calling themselves Frank, their mission is less about money and more about exposing corruption through graffiti and viral videos. However, when they collide with a powerful church involved in a money-laundering scheme, their mission spirals into a deadly game. (四个戴着兔子面具的年轻盗贼把抢劫者从富人身上拉出来。 弗兰克(Frank)自称“弗兰克 ”, 他们的任务不是金钱,而是通过涂鸦和视频视频揭露腐败。 然而,当他们与参与洗钱计划的强大教会串通时,他们的任务就变成了一场致命的游戏。)

programme.title: Ready OR Knot ((不日成婚))
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi have been together for five years since they first met in a wedding banquet, but marriage soon becomes a challenge to their relationship. Heidi sees marriage as a testimony of their love, while Guy sees it as doomsday. Can the couple resolve their conflict? Are they ready or not? (盖伊和海迪在婚宴上第一次见面以来已经在一起五年了,但婚姻很快就成为了他们关系的挑战.海迪认为婚姻是他们爱的见证,而盖伊认为这是末日.)

programme.title: Triad ((三生花))
programme.desc: This is a story about the Hong Kong Triads. Ting William Chan. Cheung Derek Tsang and Dong Edward Chui are childhood friends who join a Triad together. After joining however, they discover that fame and fortune will ultimately break them apart as only one of them can become the leader of the gang. (这是关于香港三合会的故事。 钟·威廉·陈。 张德里克·赞和东·爱德华·楚伊是童年的朋友,他们一起加入三合会。 但是,在加入后,他们发现名声和财富最终将粉碎他们,因为他们中只有一人能够成为黑帮头目。)

programme.title: Its A Wonderful Life ((好运到))
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all. (香港巨头任达库安照顾了他的四代家庭,然而他的三个儿子都面临着自己的挑战.他的女儿回到法国和她的朋友罗伯托一起学习时,一切都发生了变化.罗伯托为任家带来了一波转型,为所有人带来了新的希望和机会.)

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident ((生きてみたいもう一度 新宿バス放火事件))
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival. (中国移民铁头党在东京和移民同胞一起为生存而奋斗,然后才开始建立新的三合会。 正如他获得合法居留权并决定离开黑社会一样,警察镇压和背叛也迫使他回到一场无情的生存斗争中。)

programme.title: YOLO ((乐活姐妹：怪诞冒险))
programme.desc: Feeling lost and aimless, Le Ying chooses to withdraw from society after a short working experience. After a series of unexpected events one day, she decides to embrace life anew. She sees a chance for a fresh start when she meets a boxing coach, yet the challenges ahead far exceed her expectations, marking a vibrant start to her journey. (黎英在短短的工作经历之后选择退出社会。 一天,在一系列意外事件之后,她决定重新拥抱生活。 当她遇到拳击教练时,她看到了重新开始的机会,但前面的挑战远远超过她的期望,标志着她的旅程充满活力的开始。)

programme.title: In Broad Daylight ((盲人杀妻记))
programme.desc: Based on a true event of a news investigative unit receiving a tip-off about the abuse of residents in an Elderly and Disabled Care Home. To expose the homes wrongdoings, reporter Kay goes undercover to expose the inhumanity and unveil the cruel truth under broad daylight. (依据一个新闻调查股收到的关于虐待老年人和残疾人照料之家居民的举报的真实事件,为了揭露这些家庭不法行为,记者Kay在光天化日之下秘密揭露了不人道和残酷的真相。)

programme.title: Back to the Past ((寻秦记))
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lives in seclusion for 20 years. However, peace is shattered when a group of time travellers returns with modern weapons to seize the Qin throne. Forced to reunite after decades apart, Hong Siu Lung and Ying Zheng must fight to defend the Qin dynasty and protect the fate of history itself. (帮助英正团结中国后,洪小龙在隔离中生活了20年,然而,当一群时空旅行者带着现代武器返回时,夺回秦王位,和平就破灭了。 数十年后被迫重聚,洪小龙和英正必须奋力捍卫秦王,保护历史的命运。)

programme.title: Vital Signs ((生死征兆))
programme.desc: Paramedic Wang partners with Ma after being reassigned to a new station. Initially, Wang disagrees with Mas unconventional methods, but over time, Ma helps him rediscover the true mission of a paramedic - saving every life. (马氏病与马氏病在被重新分配到一个新的站点后,与马氏的半医务人员合作。 起初,王氏不同意马氏非常规方法,但随着时间的推移,马氏帮助他重新发现救护人员的真正使命 — — 拯救每一条生命。)

programme.title: Cold War ((冷战风云录))
programme.desc: A hijacking of a police van occurs when the Police Commissioner is away from Hong Kong. Deputy Commissioner Lee leads a rescue operation code-named Cold War. Fellow Deputy Commissioner Sean moves to take control from Lee as he thinks Lee is emotionally affected by his son being held hostage, but the efforts end up threatening both their reputation. (警方专员离开香港后,便发生劫持警车事件。 李副局长领导了一个代号为冷战的救援行动。 肖恩副局长副局长西恩(Sean)试图控制李(Lee),因为他认为李(Lee)因儿子被扣为人质在情感上受到影响,但他的所作所为最终威胁到他们的声誉。)

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: This instant cult classic adapts three erotic and mystical tales from the Chinese classical works, with stories spanning across time from the Tang to Ming dynasties. The stories, filled with characters such as emperors, concubines, monks and fortune-tellers, intertwine in a world of adultery, lust and greed, alongside great costumes!

programme.title: The Dragon Creek ((龙虎沟))
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during Chinas early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer. (这部Wuxia谋杀神秘片讲述了一位年轻女孩的父亲在中国早期共和时代遭到无情谋杀。 她有一张恶棍的名单,他们一直在密谋反对她的父亲,并且与她的哥哥一起,这位年轻女孩开始寻找秘密的连环杀手。)

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu ((疯猴))
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chens past insult. (陈先生是一位受尊敬的子功夫大师,直到他被一个无情的恶棍入了架子和了,最终成为一个流浪艺术家.当陈在街上遇到一个年轻人,小子,他决定教他他的子功夫运动.)

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers ((街市英雄))
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hongs enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends. (少林的洪西关被逃到清廷的武术败类追赶受伤,他被来自湿市的朋友救治,他们把洪光藏在豆腐店里保护他,但香港敌人发现他,在店里伏击他,希望抓住洪光和他所有的朋友。)

programme.title: The Young Avenger ((小毒龙))
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brothers death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu? (刘晓华想为兄弟们的死报仇,在战斗中失去一只手臂,十年后发誓复仇。李明华要求姐姐送女儿宝珠去学龙剑之术,为他报仇。 保珠成长成为一名熟练的武士,与刘晓华的表弟陈氏相遇,计划进行决斗。 她能打败刘晓珠吗?)

programme.title: Hex after Hex ((邪完再邪))
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular Venom Lo Meng. (绝对是这样一个的鬼魂,却是这样一个的鬼魂! 邪教经典导演Kuei Chih-hung用这个惊人的恐怖浪漫戏剧,)

programme.title: The Golden Seal ((金海豹))
programme.desc: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his fathers death. He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge. (吴晓燕从小就练武术,为父亲的死报仇。 他遇到了一天伪装成男子的吴晓燕,突然被一群黑帮殴打。 吴恳求她父亲让她带戴雄回家康复。 戴小丹不知道这是他报仇的机会。)

programme.title: Human Lanterns ((人皮灯笼))
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Longs wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident (7年后,龙赵龙在决斗中被龙龙击败,龙龙求赵王代表他做个独特的灯笼,以赢得灯笼比赛,而赵王则计划报复。 当长妻突然消失,听到人灯的故事,长妻可能卷入其中。)

programme.title: House of Traps ((House of 青出于蓝s))
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house... (邪恶的王子把被盗的帝国宝藏藏在一个充满了诱杀刀片的房子里。 在等离子清除攻击中,英雄和流氓试图揭开房子的致命秘密...)

programme.title: Young Lovers (年轻人爱)
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock n roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls. (范,一个吉他的富人,前往日本加入一支摇滚乐队,)

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber ((少林搭棚大师))
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of scaffolding kung fu. (三部影片第二部,戈登·刘晓波剧《周任杰》,他假扮和尚,在少林省学习功夫,最终创造出自己的少林手架功夫风格。)

programme.title: Dawn Will Come ((魂断奈何天))
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parents consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her (梁才给美丽的邱荣下了药,强奸了她,但答应在得到父母同意后娶她。此后,没有关于他求婚的消息,而邱荣在发现自己怀孕时与梁才对质。这时,她发现他已经娶了一个高贵的富裕女孩,甚至计划杀害她。)

programme.title: Brotherhood ((龙争虎斗))
programme.desc: Liu Da Jiang, a naive young man, is betrayed and hunted by his sworn brothers after a gold robbery goes wrong. Surviving against the odds, he gains the favour of a gang leader and embarks on a path of revenge with bodyguard Jin Yan. As rival gangs clash and feelings emerge, a violent underworld showdown becomes inevitable. (刘大江是一个天真的年轻人,在一次金盗出错后被他的宣誓兄弟背叛和猎杀。 他幸免于险,赢得了黑帮领袖的青睐,与保镖金燕一起走上了复仇之路。 随着敌对帮派的冲突和感情的出现,一场暴力的地下大决战不可避免。)

programme.title: The 82 Tenants ((82家房客))
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy House of 72 tenants, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood? (继续经典喜剧"72人房"的成功,这部续集讲述了香港老建筑住户被开发商迫驱逐的故事.一些租户更喜欢接受补偿,而一些则反对此举.收购计划将破坏邻居的和吗?)

programme.title: The Flag of Iron ((铁旗门))
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with The Five Venoms actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes. You have the good guys from the righteous clan versus the bad guys from the villainous clan and its so filled with dont-blink-or-you-will-miss-something gags, you will need to watch it over and over again so you can see the things you missed. (当超级导演张哲发现五毒演员的新才华和鲜血时, 大部分都是在中国高清歌剧中受训的, 并且精通奇异武术武器, 这为他在电影中使用奇异武器创造了新的火花。 《铁旗》是他导演的20部电影之一, 其中一部是这5个家伙制作的彻底挥舞和体力耗尽的动作。 你们有正派部落的好人, 而不是恶派部落的坏人, 里面充满了多管闲事的杂耍, 你们需要一遍又一遍地看一遍, 才能看到你们错过的东西。)

programme.title: Spring Blossoms ((新一剪梅))
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia. (Shaw Brothers中一些1970年代最大的女性明星 分享了这个年轻爱情和干扰父母的故事 主角是Lily Li、Shu Pei Pei和Essie Lin Chia。)

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot ((少林海燈大師))
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time. (少林少林教主派和尚奇三去向吴当神父学习特别的武术,他在清和明阵营的战斗中被蒙骗,必须同时召集门徒重建被烧焦的少林寺庙。)

programme.title: Heads For Sale ((女侠卖人头))
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge. (胡是一位正直勇敢的剑士,她会为她爱的罗罗做任何事情.当罗罗被腐败警察送入监狱时,她开始释放他,并毫不犹地砍下两名保卫人的头部.在这个过程中,她也遇到了父亲的老敌人,他回来寻求报复.)

programme.title: The Golden Knight ((牙狼))
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth (玉飞霞女英雄被控偷窃武术秘密书,为证明她无罪,她假扮成男子汉,进入少林寺了解真相)

programme.title: Double Bliss ((双喜临门))
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dongs songs, leading to double bliss for the couple. (东中和朱计划结婚,但他们的家族是终身竞争对手,不赞成。 他们决定假自杀,最终让父母双方解决分歧并批准婚姻。 同时,一家唱片公司宣布他们将发行东斯歌曲,为夫妇带来双欢。)

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox (狐的传说)
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the mens help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father. (一位年轻人(Chin)认为他是一个孤儿,直到他遇见了三个人,并向他们学习到他的父亲是一位伟大的剑客,他的父亲在试图消除关于不法行为的谣言并将丢失的剑还给其合法主人时被杀害了。 Chin寻找男人帮助报复他父亲的不法死亡。)

programme.title: Madam White Snake ((新白蛇传))
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split... (琳达林戴是完美的作为帕克苏,一个惊人的蛇女神,她以女性的形式,以至于她可以品尝人类生活的快乐!帕克诱惑年轻学者,Hsu Hsien当她承认他作为她的救主在另一个生命1000年前.)

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo ((通天小子红枪客))
programme.desc: Young Bao Tong witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by a vicious villain. A large eagle tattoo on Baos chest was spotted by the killer as he escapes. Can Bao escape from the killer? (青宝东亲眼目睹了恶毒的恶棍残酷杀害他的功夫大师。凶手在Baos的胸口发现一个大老鹰纹身。)

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City ((解密紫禁城))
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor. (法官发现李新生儿在出生时被换换,女皇20年前驱逐她出宫殿.他让女士承认与女皇的阴谋.女皇因她的行为被定罪,李女士最终与她现在的儿子重聚.)

programme.title: The Mighty One ((后院活宝))
programme.desc: Lung seeks five volumes of a renowned Kung Fu manual to gain invincibility. When he believes a martial arts school master possesses the volumes, he kills him and his daughter but leaves behind a young brother and sister. Years later, Lung loses two volumes and starts another bloody hunt but each attempt is interrupted by two mysterious warriors... (龙龙寻找五卷著名的功夫手册,以获得不可战胜力。当他相信武术师傅拥有这本书时,他杀死他和他的女儿,但留下一个弟弟妹妹。 几年后,龙龙输了两卷,又开始了另一次血腥狩猎,但每次尝试都被两个神秘的战士打断...)

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber1977 (红厅的梦想)
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple. (根据同名的中国经典小说,著名的贾家族的儿子尤深深爱上了他的表弟戴尤.然而,他的母亲不赞成他们的关系,并计划安排尤嫁给另一个富裕的女孩,导致完美的夫妇的悲惨结局.)

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters (主人的挑战)
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his fathers martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hungs passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lus disciple. (黄飞鸿必须证明自己值得卢师傅(也是他父亲的武术老师)的教导。 尽管在一次比赛中被击败,但黄飞鸿对功夫的热情终于让卢一举,让他成为卢二世的徒弟。)

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Mark Antony
programme.desc: Mark, the son of a former gangster, comes across a mobile phone that can time-travel. Using the phone, Mark acquires the ability to save his estranged mother from a grim fate.

programme.title: Ghost
programme.desc: After a young man is murdered, his spirit stays behind to warn his lover of impending danger, with the help of a reluctant psychic.

programme.title: Goli Soda

programme.title: Dhanusu Raasi Neyargalae

programme.title: Kaalidas

programme.desc: An aged villager comes to the city and sets people right.

But he and the witness develop feelings, complicating matters. (腐败大亨杀害了犯罪证人,只有与中国政府有联系的商人的女朋友才看到了。北京保镖帮助香港警察保护她。但他和证人发展感情,使事情复杂化。)

programme.title: Back To The Future III ((回到未来3))
programme.desc: In Back to the Future Part III, Marty travels to 1885 to save Doc from an outlaw. Packed with laughs, action, and heart, its the epic Wild West finale to the beloved trilogy. (回到未来第三部分,马蒂旅行到1885年,从一个逃犯手中救救医生。 充满了欢笑、行动与心脏,这是史无前例的狂野西部决赛,也是最美好的三部曲。)

programme.title: Widows ((寡妇湾))
programme.desc: Set in contemporary Chicago, amidst a time of turmoil, four women with nothing in common except a debt left behind by their dead husbands criminal activities, take fate into their own hands, and conspire to forge a future on their own terms. (在当代芝加哥,在动荡的时代, 四个女人除了她们死去的丈夫留下的一笔债务之外, 毫无共同之处, 犯罪活动,)

programme.title: Tiger Island ((虎岛))
programme.desc: Returning to Nepal, the film crew use thermal cameras and drones to follow tigers after dark, revealing a hidden world of previously unseen behaviour and surprise encounters. (影片摄制组回到尼泊尔后, 使用热摄像头和无人机跟踪老虎,)

programme.title: Robson Greens Weekend Escapes ((Robson Greens Weekend 逃出生天s))
programme.desc: Robson takes football pundit Chris Kamara on a trip to North York Moors National Park. They take high tea on a steam train, overnight in a glamping pod and hunt for fossils. (Robson在去北约克摩尔斯国家公园的旅途中 选了足球专家Chris Kamara。他们在蒸汽列车上喝高茶, 晚上在迷人的舱子里,)

programme.title: Robson Greens Weekend Escapes ((Robson Greens Weekend 逃出生天s))
programme.desc: Robsons in the Cairngorms, joined by Gail Porter. They cycle around Loch Malachie before trying to get a glimpse of ospreys in the wild. Poetry, fresh air and landscapes make for a restful weekend. (盖尔·波特加入的罗布森(Robsons in the Cairngorms) 。 他们环绕马拉奇湖环绕着马拉奇湖,然后试图看到野外的。 诗歌、新鲜空气和风景可以让一个宁静的周末。)

programme.desc: Sue heads south to the enticing turquoise waters of Phuket, the countrys largest island. Making her diving debut, she learns how destructive humans can be to the fragile coral reefs. (苏向南走去普吉岛这个最大的岛屿的令人羡慕的绿绿洲水域。 在她首次潜水时,她学会了人类对脆弱珊瑚礁的破坏力。)

programme.title: Hippo Watch with Steve Backshall (Steve Backshall的河马观察)
programme.desc: Having been fearful of hippos since a young boy, Steve Backshall sets out to discover why hippos are considered the most dangerous animals in Africa, and if their aggressive reputation is misunderstood. (Steve Backshall从小一个男孩起就害怕河马,)

programme.title: Great Asian Railway Journeys ((亚洲铁路纪行))
programme.desc: Michael Portillos railway tour reaches its final stop - Singapore. Michael walks the streets of Chinatown with a local artist and uncovers the history of the Chinese community there. (迈克尔·波蒂略斯的铁路巡演到达了最后的终点 — — 新加坡。迈克尔和一位当地艺术家在唐人街上走在唐人街上,揭露了那里的中国社会的历史。)

programme.title: The Worlds Deadliest Weather ((世界最致命的天气))
programme.desc: Devastating floods in Italy, a mass evacuation in a Canadian wildfire, a deadly Texan storm surge and ferocious volcanic eruptions in Iceland. (意大利发生了毁灭性的洪水,加拿大大火灾造成的大规模疏散,)

programme.title: Airborne ((中文))
programme.desc: Plot a course for adventure as animals go on remarkable journeys through the skies. Navigate a wooden labyrinth with a speedy goshawk, join a sandgrouses trek to a distant watering hole, and see a murmuration of starlings mesmerize their nemesis. (随着动物在天空中进行非凡的旅程, 探索一条木材迷宫, 带着快速的鱼, 加入一条沙地游行, 到一个遥远的水槽, 看到 子的语 迷恋 他们的敌人.)

programme.title: A Wild Year On Earth ((狂野地球))
programme.desc: Watch summer unfold in the Northern Hemisphere, while regions close to the equator enter the wet season and Southern Africa goes dry, creating scarcity for some creatures and bounty for others. (在北半球,夏天的光,在赤道附近的地区进入潮季节,南非干燥,)

programme.title: A Wild Year On Earth ((狂野地球))
programme.desc: Witness some of the planets most dramatic natural shifts in July, from the Arctic ice sheets that come crashing down during the summer melt to the feeding frenzy when sockeye salmon reach the end of their journey in Alaska. (7月,一些行星发生了最剧烈的自然变化, 从夏季的北极冰盖崩塌到 袜子鲑鱼到达阿拉斯加旅程的尽头时,)

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running With The Pack (野狗:与群众一起跑)
programme.desc: Agonize over a lost Stork pack puppy, and tussle with Manzi pups who are sorting their place in the hierarchy, figuring out noisy-neighbor friends and foes. Hop on a search mission with Julz for the missing Kakuli pack in the desolate Badlands. (和曼齐小狗一起苦恼,他们正在分清自己在等级体系中的地位,了解吵闹的邻居朋友和敌人。 和朱尔兹一起前往寻找在荒凉的荒地失踪的卡库利小狗。)

programme.title: A Wild Year On Earth ((狂野地球))
programme.desc: Watch summer unfold in the Northern Hemisphere, while regions close to the equator enter the wet season and Southern Africa goes dry, creating scarcity for some creatures and bounty for others. (在北半球,夏天的光,在赤道附近的地区进入潮季节,南非干燥,)

programme.title: A Wild Year On Earth ((狂野地球))
programme.desc: Witness some of the planets most dramatic natural shifts in July, from the Arctic ice sheets that come crashing down during the summer melt to the feeding frenzy when sockeye salmon reach the end of their journey in Alaska. (7月,一些行星发生了最剧烈的自然变化, 从夏季的北极冰盖崩塌到 袜子鲑鱼到达阿拉斯加旅程的尽头时,)

programme.title: Planet Weird ((星際姊妹))
programme.desc: Step into the ring with natures top brawlers, who use violence to get what they need. Watch the cannibalistic Portia spider devour the competition, uncover the bloodthirsty side of cuddly koalas, and catch an epic neck-whipping giraffe battle. (与自然界顶尖的种植者一起踏入竞技场,他们使用暴力来获得他们所需要的东西。看着食人派的波西娅蜘蛛吞噬竞争对手,揭开可爱的考拉的血腥一面,并进行一场史诗般的颈部鞭笞长颈鹿战斗。)

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue ((马拉威野生拯救队))
programme.desc: Witness veterinarian Dr. Amanda Salb save an elephant calf caught in a poachers snare, racing time to treat the wound. Back at the base, an orphaned baby baboon meets his new family. A monitor lizard and duiker are returned to freedom in the wild. (Amanda Salb 医生拯救了一只被偷猎者捕捉的大象小牛,比赛时间是治疗伤口的时间。在基地,一只孤儿幼崽在基地遇到了他的新家人。一只监测蜥蜴和杜克在野外重获自由。)

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue ((马拉威野生拯救队))
programme.desc: Amanda puts a radio collar on one of the first cheetah cubs born in Malawi in twenty years and the team struggles to give a 4-meter python a physical. See a group of tourists deliver a rambunctious baby monkey they rescued from the pet trade. (阿曼达在20年来出生于马拉维的第一只猎豹幼崽之一上贴了无线电项圈,团队竭力要给一只4米长的象牙做体能。 看到一群游客运送一只从宠物行业救出来的笨拙的幼猴。)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Zambia is home to three very special and different African Edens. The low, hot Luangwa River Valley, the high, dry Liuwa Plain and the cool, wet Kasanka National Park. Defined by the earth on which they sit and shaped by the seasons, each place offers something unique to the wildlife that chooses to live there. (赞比亚拥有三个非常特殊和不同的非洲沙漠。 低、热、热的Luangwa河谷、高、干枯的Liuwa平原和凉爽、湿润的Kasanka国家公园。 每一个地方都为选择在那里生活的野生动物提供了独特的地方。)

programme.title: Into The Wild Colombia ((进入野外：哥伦比亚))
programme.desc: The flat savannas of the Colombian Llanos are governed by seasonal extremes that push life to the brink. In this unforgiving arena, there are no second chances, and only creatures best adapted to their brutal extremes will make it through a year. (哥伦比亚兰诺斯的平原草原受季节性极端的支配,这些极端将生命推向边缘。 在这个无情的竞技场中,没有第二次机会,只有最适合其残酷极端的动物才能度过一年。)

programme.title: A Wild Year On Earth ((狂野地球))

programme.title: 13 Hours To Survive (13个小时的生存时间)
programme.desc: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool. (在潮水池中,一个隐居的螃蟹之家狩猎,一只幼猫跑到陌生的邻居那里,一只章鱼恐怖猎物。 观察海鸥和其他动物在海面上捕猎,因为那里的热量上升,水中氧气消耗。)

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running With The Pack (野狗:与群众一起跑)
programme.desc: Dodge a leopard with the Manzi dogs while they treat themselves to a stolen feast. No such luck for the Kakuli pack on the hunt, as theyre foiled by a brave puku antelope. Find the stork pack, and retreat from charging elephants with Jules and Simon. (与曼齐犬一起躲藏一只豹子,而他们却把自己当作一个被偷的宴会。 猎杀的卡库利包没有那么幸运,因为它们被勇敢的马库蚂蚁打败了。 找到鹿包,并不再用朱尔斯和西蒙来指控象。)

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue ((马拉威野生拯救队))

programme.title: Planet Weird ((星際姊妹))
programme.desc: Get inside the toughest gangs that roam the Earth and see what true grit looks like in the wild. Chase a band of marauding locusts, watch the coconut octopus ambush its next meal, and meet a flock of finches whove developed a taste for blood. (进入在地球上游荡的最凶恶的帮派,看看野外真正的暴徒长什么样。 追寻一群掠夺性的蝗虫,看着椰子章鱼伏击下一个食物,见到一群尝到血味的狐狸。)

programme.title: Ningaloo: Australias Ocean Wonder ((宁格鲁：澳大利亚的海洋奇观))
programme.desc: Learn how Ningaloos conservation miracle could inspire humans to pull the planet back from the brink of climatic destruction. Visit an abandoned whaling station and other ruins that show we have the tools, if only we can find the will to change. (学习宁格洛斯保护奇迹如何激励人类将地球从气候破坏的边缘拉回。 参观废弃的捕鲸站和其他废墟,这些废墟表明我们拥有工具,如果我们能找到改变的意志的话。)

programme.title: Turtle Beach ((龟滩沥血))
programme.desc: Locals call it the arribada, or arrival. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs. (当地人称之为" arribada",即到达.)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Zambias Luangwa Valley is home to Africas biggest and most fearsome giants, but what really makes it special are its birds. There are over 400 different species here each perfectly adapted to exploit every opportunity on offer. (桑比亚斯·卢昂瓦谷是非洲最大和最可怕的巨人的家园,但真正使它特别的是它的鸟类。这里有400多个不同的物种,每个物种都完全适合利用每一个机会。)

programme.title: Into The Wild Colombia ((进入野外：哥伦比亚))
programme.desc: Mona, a female cotton top tamarin is all alone in her tropical forest home. She has left the security of her birth family to search for an unrelated troop which might provide her with a future mate. (莫娜,一个女棉花马林,独自一人在热带森林的家里. 她离开了她的生儿家庭的安全,)

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue ((马拉威野生拯救队))

programme.title: 13 Hours To Survive (13个小时的生存时间)
programme.desc: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance. (当太阳落山和捕食者在潮汐最终来临之前在游泳池周围游荡时,数数几秒钟。 夜以继日的夜幕随风飘落,有一只鳄鱼般的鼻涕虫和扇贝,而一对狡猾的螃蟹则冒着危险的浪漫之险。)

programme.title: Olivia

programme.title: Olivia

For our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, Pillow Cat sings a song!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: When Phoebes Gratitude Day card flies away before she can give it to Marcus, the Dews try to help her recreate it - perfectly. When Athena finds herself a little short-handed at the Fairhaven Summer Fair, her cousin, Reed, comes to help only to give Athena more problems to fix.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: When Harpers ceramic dragon is smashed, the Dews must find all the pieces. But when a piece ends up missing, the Dews work together to create a new piece, hoping no one will notice. Dylan goes to great lengths to invite his Dew Drop to his soccer game but, in the process, learns that sometimes believing in something is more powerful than seeing something.

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a cup of crayons and a coloring book with the same doodle on every page. But when CatRat gets stuck inside the book, Gabby and Pandy must go on a doodle rescue mission to save him.

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse
programme.desc: Its time for a safari adventure in the dollhouse! Carlita, decked out like a safari truck, takes Gabby and Pandy on an adventure through the dollhouse as they follow clues to find the mysterious Felis Catus and discover all kinds of other dollhouse wildlife along the way! For the COTD segment, Cakey and Parrot show us how to make adorable safari snacks.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild
programme.desc: When Alex realizes hes too small to climb onto his new habitat stage, he feels too small for his dreams- until he hears of a big, new roller coaster at Coney Island and figures if he can ride the big coaster, thatll prove that hes a BIG deal! But when Alex is too short to be allowed on the ride- and his friends find themselves stuck at the top of it- Alex saves the day when he realizes that there are advantages to being small, and learns that his body is perfect just the way it is.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild
programme.desc: The habitat is celebrating Sloth Day in honor of its newest arrival: cool, chill, Lucia the sloth, who just arrived from Costa Rica! At first, the gang is excited to have a new friend, but soon the whole zoo develops sloth fever everywhere they go, people are walking around in sloth masks-- even Kate is fawning over her! programme.title: UFC Fight Night: Nurmagomedov vs. Song - Main
programme.desc: UFC heads back to Shanghai this summer with a fight card at SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center on Saturday, August 29 headlined by a crucial pairing in the bantamweight division as Umar Nurmagomedov takes on The Kung Fu Kid Song Yadong. Nurmagomedov carries a 20-1 record into second main event assignment, having earned consecutive wins over Deiveson Figueiredo and Mario Bautista since coming up short on his attempt to claim the bantamweight title. The 28-year-old Song makes his second consecutive headlining turn in his home country, looking to build off his second-round submission win over Figueiredo in Macau in May while collecting the biggest win of his career.

programme.desc: UFC returns to Sacramento for the first time in seven years on Saturday, August 23, bringing a UFC Fight Night event to Golden 1 Center headlined by a meeting between ranked middleweights Anthony Fluffy Hernandez and Gregory Robocop Rodrigues. A NorCal native, Hernandez collected finishes over Edmen Shahbazyan, Michel Pereira, and Roman Dolidze during the course of an eight-fight winning streak that was halted earlier this year by current champ Sean Strickland. programme.title: 絕命法官
programme.desc: 馬山寶駕駛肇事車離開舊城區時，意外捲入韓奎龍的韓幫與戚長榮的舊城幫之間的火拼 唐萱帶隊平息騷亂，將現場所有人帶回警局，馬山寶因涉嫌偷車被拘 在曹威爾求助后，秦譽立即委託周洛雯為其辯護 與此同時，情報科總督察石志揚與總警司達伽馬商議對策，石志揚認為戚長榮藉機擴張勢力，提議特許韓奎龍暫時出獄探子以制衡局勢 立刻釋放被捕幫眾這一粉飾太平的做法引發唐萱及其上司胡堅的不滿 秦譽一面安撫受驚的兒子，一面暗中處理善後 然而唐萱很快發現秦譽那被盜車輛與韓剛車禍有關，要求扣車取證 秦譽被迫配合調查，陷入用謊言掩蓋謊言的困境 由於車輛登記在秦譽岳母沈寧（退休法官）名下，沈寧前來關心外孫，交談中透露出秦一唯母親死亡可能另有隱情 法庭上，周洛雯為遭警員毆打受傷的馬山寶據理力爭，但法官盧維德駁回了取保候審申請，下令補充偵查七天 唐萱通知秦譽，車輛鑒定結果確認，這正是撞傷韓剛的肇事車

programme.title: 광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.desc: Innu-aimun, Uashat and Pessamit The recruits go for rifle training and confront their fears at the shooting range. The personal growth is palpable. Later, they take a helicopter flight and worry about how intense their next challenge will be.

programme.title: Kanienkha Animal Nation
programme.desc: Kanienkha, Kanienkha Kahnawke and Six Nations Indigenous communities like the Kainai Blood Tribe revive their deep cultural and ecological ties to the bison with the help of Elk Island National Park, which reintroduces them to the prairies.

programme.title: Blackfoot Secret History
programme.desc: Blackfoot, Siksika A fearless Blackfoot matriarch, orphaned in youth, surpasses her male counterparts in horse raids and battles. Her unwavering pursuit of glory comes to fruition when she leads her war party on an unforeseen horse raid.

programme.title: Blackfoot Poken the Bear
programme.desc: Blackfoot, Siksika Rod examines the legacy of the 94 calls to action, tracing the gap between promises and progress, exploring what real reconciliation looks like and delving into what still needs to be done.

programme.title: Michif Country
programme.desc: Mtis Elder Earl St. Goddard spends his days outdoors hunting, trapping and fishing with his family Earl and his family share their favorite winter activities with Indigenous leader Sheila North Wilson.

programme.title: Michif Red River Gold
programme.desc: Michif, French Memphis and the team return to the Caribou Bog in the dead of winter to resume the search on frozen ground. With the help of Roger and some heavy equipment, they break through the ice to pull out their biggest find yet.

programme.title: Nsyilxcen Quest Out West Wild Food
programme.desc: Nsyilxcen Tracey meets Jaye Siegmueller, the owner of Farm Bound, and learns about their organic food delivery service. She then returns home to learn from Dawn Russell about food preservation. Tracey also speaks with Tessa Terbasket.

programme.title: Nsyilxcen Merchants of the Wild
programme.desc: Nsyilxcen Two groups of strangers are dropped deep into the mountains of British Columbia. With no modern technology, the group struggles to build shelter and live the way their ancestors have since time immemorial.
